jobs.title: Accounts Executive
jobs.description:
Accounts Executive - Swatch Group

Accounts Executive
The company
The Swatch Group is the number one manufacturer of finished watches in the world. The Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, jewelry, and watch movements and components. It produces nearly all of the components necessary to manufacture the watches sold under its 16 watch brands and the multi-brand Tourbillon and Hour Passion retail labels, as well as the entire Swiss watchmaking industry.
In addition, it operates its own worldwide network of distribution organizations. The Swatch Group is also a key player in the electronic systems sector.
Job description
We are looking for an Accounts Executive to be responsible for Accounts Receivable, Reporting and Fixed Assets Management. The position will report to the Finance Manager and be part of the finance team
Accounts Receivable
• Perform full spectrum of AR functions, including posting and matching of collections, reconciliation for incoming bank receipt
• Issue SOA and actively follow up on overdue receivables to ensure timely collections
• Reconcile sales invoice to SAP entries
• Collaboration with internal and external stakeholders on AR related queries and issues
• Check and issue credit note for sales target incentive to retailers & salesman sell-out incentive
• Support in the preparation of monthly intercompany debit note (eg, TSGM)
• Generate AR Overdue report for sales order release and HQ reporting
• Fixed Assets
• Process Fixed Assets addition, disposal and write offs according to company policies
• Maintain and update Fixed Asset register
• Run and post monthly Depreciation
• Coordinate and support physical asset verification
• Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standard
• Account Closing
• Prepare accrual entries, including Mall loyalty points and Gross Turnover (GTO) expenses
• Support month end closing activities, including analysis for indirect expenses and HQ reporting package
• Preparation of bank reconciliation
• Ad-Hoc
• Participate in stock-take exercise
• Other ad-hoc task as required
• Profile
• Diploma in Accountancy or equivalent
• Working knowledge of SAP is an added advantage.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and ERP
• Good initiative, meticulous and a good team player
• Professional requirements
• Min 2-3 years relevant working experience in accounting environment
• Languages
• English
• Contact
• Apply to us with your CV today!

jobs.title: Mécanicien de ligne
jobs.description:
Mécanicien de ligne - Swatch Group

Mécanicien de ligne
Introduction de la société
Nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs contribuent, grâce à leur savoir-faire, leur passion et leur engagement, au succès des montres, des mouvements et des composants d’horlogerie Swiss Made fabriqués par ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse. Notre entreprise fait partie de Swatch Group, le plus grand Groupe horloger mondial avec 16 marques de grande renommée et des sociétés de production hautement spécialisées dans l’horlogerie ainsi que dans d’autres secteurs industriels.
• Afin de renforcer notre équipe de production, nous sommes à la recherche pour notre site, d'un(e) :
• Description du poste
• Vous êtes responsable du bon fonctionnement des machines de production : entretien, réglages, réparations et dépannages
• Vous assurez la mise en train des différents calibres et modèles sur les lignes automatisées
• Vous garantissez la fabrication et/ou l’entretien de l’outillage nécessaire à la bonne marche des lignes de montage
• Moteur dans le développement et la modernisation des équipements de production, vous amenez des améliorations continues à la fabrication des produits et des prototypes
• Vous êtes garant de la qualité du produit final selon les spécifications techniques
• Vous participez de manière active à la production
• Profil
• Vous êtes au bénéfice d’un CFC de polymécanicien ou d’une formation équivalente
• Compétences requises
• Flexible et résistant au stress, vous êtes disposé à travailler en horaires d’équipes (2 équipes en alternance)
• Vous montrez un intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies et êtes ouvert aux formations
• Autonome et doté d’un esprit d’initiative, vous êtes rigoureux et orienté solution
• Vous faites preuve d’entregent et d’un fort esprit d’équipe
• Langues
• Maîtrise du français, l’allemand est un plus
• Personne de contact
• Marc Bise
• HR Business Partner
• Lieu de travail
• Route de la Piscine 20
• 1950 Sion (Valais)
• Suisse
• Adresse de l'entreprise
• ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse
• Schild-Rust-Strasse 17
• 2540 Grenchen
• Postuler pour ce poste
• Partagez cette annonce

jobs.title: Chef de projet Industrialisation
jobs.description:
Chef de projet Industrialisation - Swatch Group

Chef de projet Industrialisation
Introduction de la société
Nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs contribuent, grâce à leur savoir-faire, leur passion et leur engagement, au succès des montres, des mouvements et des composants d’horlogerie Swiss Made fabriqués par ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse. Notre entreprise fait partie de Swatch Group, le plus grand Groupe horloger mondial avec 16 marques de grande renommée et des sociétés de production hautement spécialisées dans l’horlogerie ainsi que dans d’autres secteurs industriels.
• Afin de compléter l’équipe Industrialisation au sein de la BU Swatch, nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) :
• Description du poste
• Gestion de projets industriels : Piloter les projets liés à l’intégration de nouveaux moyens de production et à l’optimisation des processus d’assemblage.
• Industrialisation : Mettre en place les processus de fabrication et garantir leur conformité aux exigences techniques.
• Rédaction technique : Rédiger les cahiers des charges pour les équipements, établir les documentations et assurer le suivi des appels d’offres.
• Analyse économique et gestion des investissements : Évaluer la rentabilité des projets, formuler des demandes d’investissement et suivre les budgets.
• Coordination et collaboration : Assurer la communication et la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.
• Mise en service des équipements : Assurer la mise en service des installations de montage et de test, y compris la formation des équipes de production.
• Soutien process : Apporter un appui technique dans l’évolution des produits et veiller à l’optimisation des processus tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Ramp-up et tests : Gérer le déploiement des processus et tests pour les produits Swatch et Flik Flak.
• Profil
• Diplôme supérieur en microtechnique, mécanique, automation ou dans un domaine technique connexe
• Compétences requises
• Flexible, agile et résistant au stress, vous êtes orienté solution et avez une bonne force de persuasion
• Autonome, proactif et doté d’un fort esprit d’initiative, vous êtes inventif et pragmatique
• Ouvert au consensus et doté d’un fort esprit d’équipe, vous possédez néanmoins une bonne force de persuasion
• Vous disposez d’un excellent sens de la communication
• Langues
• Maîtrise du français, bonnes connaissances de l’allemand et/ou de l’anglais requises
• Personne de contact
• Marie Freiha
• HR Business Partner
• Lieu de travail
• Route de la Piscine 20
• 1950 Sion (Valais)
• Suisse
• Adresse de l'entreprise
• ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse
• Schild-Rust-Strasse 17
• 2540 Grenchen
• Postuler pour ce poste
• Partagez cette annonce

jobs.title: Store Manager
jobs.description:
Store Manager - Swatch Group

Store Manager
The company
TISSOT, founded in 1853 in the Jura Valley, embodies the perfect balance between watchmaking heritage and bold innovation.
A global reference, it blends precision, contemporary design, and a constant drive to explore new materials and technologies. Its strong connection to international sports reinforces a dynamic identity, as official timekeeper for major world competitions.
Job description
We’re opening doors to something new in Madrid —
Looking for a Store Manager ready to lead our new Tissot Boutique, inspire the team, and make an impact from day one
Key
• Responsibilities
Drive revenue growth, oversee daily operations, and lead the sales team with a hands‑on, people‑first approach.
Develop strategies and action plans to achieve sales targets through clientelling, exceptional service, events, partnerships, and traffic‑driving initiatives.
Ensure a consistent, high‑quality in‑store experience aligned with brand standards.
Think strategically and make decisions that elevate store performance.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, and manage administrative tasks while adapting to evolving business needs.
Maximize inventory efficiency and maintain strong cash‑control and loss‑prevention practices.
Profile
The ideal candidate should be an experienced retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills.
Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to detail.
The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus.
Professional requirements
Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Boutique needs.
Availability for shift work.
Intermediate level of informatics (Office).
Languages
Conversation level of English.
Knowledge in other language would be a plus.
Contact
empleo@es.swatchgroup.com

Spain

jobs.title: Senior Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City
jobs.description:
Senior Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City - Swatch Group

• Senior Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City
• The company
• The Swatch Group is an international group active in the manufacture
• and sale of finished watches, jewelry, watch movements and components.
• Swatch Group supplies nearly all components required for the watches sold
• by its 17 watch and jewelry brands as well as by its two retail brands,
• Tourbillon and Hour Passion. The Group’s production companies also supply
• movements and components to third-party watchmakers. The Swatch
• Group is also a key player in the manufacture and sale of electronic
• systems used in watchmaking and other industries. With its watch brands, it
• is also a leader in the field of sports event timing as official timekeeper and
• data-handler of most of the Olympic Games of the last decades and major
• international sports events. The Swatch Group has a unique emotional
• culture. Beauty, sensuality, emotions in watches are as much part of it as
• high-tech, quality and added value on the customer’s wrist. Both, emotional
• poetry and innovation play an active part in the commitment to its
• customers. The Swatch Group was founded in 1983, by Nicolas G. Hayek.
• It grew out of the merger of two big Swiss watch groups, ASUAG and SSIH.
• The Group has since shown steady growth in key financials, leading to
• records. Today Swatch Group employs more than 33,500 people in over 50
• countries.
• Job description
• Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a fast friendly service.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Swatch products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to guaranteed and after sales service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly sales targets.
• Oversee colleagues on the shop floor to ensure best practise is adhered to at all times, providing on the spot feedback when required
• Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way
• Reporting
• Accurate reporting of all administration and stock control.
• Collation of sales figures.
• Clearly articulate/communicate any issues the store has had in the absence of the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager
• Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Delegate tasks to colleagues to ensure productivity during peak trade
• Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Hold briefing sessions in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.
• Confident to communicate at all levels, within the Store and with the wider Swatch Group teams
• Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
• Be familiar with international customer’s customs and culture.
• Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training programmes.
• Confidently deliver product knowledge and train colleagues on upcoming collections
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
• Other
• To undertake duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
• As a member of the store management team be prepared to act up in a more senior capacity when the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager are out of the business
• Assist the store management team to lead and inspire your colleagues.
• Ensure service standards and behaviours are in line with training and Swatch guidelines at all times
• Profile
• Essential
• Passionate to lead, motivate and engage a team
• Driven to improve conversion and ensure the store and team meet KPIs
• Enjoys developing team members, with the ability to provide constructive and positive feedback
• Passionate about providing the highest level of customer experience, leading by example for other team members
• Uses initiative to support the Store Manager and Assistant Manager in running the store and providing ideas for improvements
• Preferred
• Previous experience in retail and/or fashion accessories
• Have experience dealing with international customers
• Ability to communicate in multiple languages
• Previous Supervisory experience
• Contact
• Kevin Charles
• Job location
• Ariel Way Unit K2004A
• W12 7GF London (England)
• United Kingdom
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (UK) Limited
• 77 Marsh Wall
• 12th Floor
• London E14 9SH

jobs.description:
Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Birmingham - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Birmingham
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance.
OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
To provide exceptional levels of customer service to all clients. Merchandise, promote and sale of all OMEGA products. Meeting all sales targets and Boutique objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Sales
• Greet and serve all clients providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that clients can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other OMEGA products.
• Provide reliable information to clients in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every client, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards.
Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present, and conduct, themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international clients and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly to clients and colleagues.
Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
• To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
Professional requirements
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Previous experience from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail background.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for OMEGA, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
Job location
Upper Mall East Bull Ring Shopping Centre
B5 4BG Birmingham (England)
United Kingdom
Company address
The Swatch Group (UK) Limited
77 Marsh Wall
12th Floor
London E14 9SH

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Times Square (NY) - Swatch Group Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Times Square (NY) Die Firma Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von fertigen Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten präsent und auch in der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrwerken und Komponenten aktiv. Die Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter ihrem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Mehrmarkennetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Akteur bei fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrenindustrie und andere Industrien unerlässlich sind. Swatch umfasst die Werte, die in der Welt der Kunst, des Designs, der Mode und der Technologie existieren; und verleiht ihnen einen eigenen Funken Kreativität. Daher wird Swatch als eine Leinwand betrachtet, auf die eine Vielzahl von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Modernster Stil, trendige Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen über den Besitz einer Swatch beigetragen. Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über Verkaufserfahrung im Einzelhandel sowie über Keyholder-Hintergrund. Diese Position muss außergewöhnliche Kundenservice-Fähigkeiten und ein Verhalten besitzen, das ein großes Gefühl der Zugänglichkeit verkörpert. Der Kandidat sollte auch in der Lage sein, die Verkaufsziele zu erreichen oder zu übertreffen, und einen starken Wunsch haben, etwas über unsere Uhren zu erfahren und ein wesentliches Mitglied unseres Teams zu werden
• Stundensatz: 18,48 $ - 20,48 $ / Stunde. (Plus Provision)
• Profil
• Kunden rechtzeitig, professionell und persönlich begrüßen
• Produktwissen und Auswahl nutzen, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
• Ihre Verkaufsziele erreichen und übertreffen

• Vergütung: Basislohn und -pflege
• Professionelle Anforderungen
• 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einem Schlüsselhalter oder einer leitenden Verkaufsposition
• Angetrieben, um Ihren Kunden einen überlegenen Service zu bieten
• Ihre Kunden in die Kultur der Marke SWATCH einzubinden
• In der Lage, als Teamplayer in einer schnelllebigen, energiegeladenen Umgebung gut zu arbeiten
• In der Lage, Ziele zu planen, festzulegen und zu erreichen
• Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
• Leistungsprogramm
• Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleichen Chancen, der Vielfalt fördert und sich für ökologische Nachhaltigkeit einsetzt und wir freuen uns, die folgenden Vorteile für unsere Teilzeitpositionen anzubieten:

jobs.title: Project Manager - Low Power Wireless SoC Design
jobs.description:
Project Manager - Low Power Wireless SoC Design - Swatch Group

Project Manager - Low Power Wireless SoC Design
The company
EM Microelectronic, part of the Swatch Group, is a Swiss semiconductor company specializing in the design and production of ultra-low-power, low-voltage integrated circuits. Its solutions support a wide range of applications, including IoT, consumer, industrial, automotive, and medical markets. With international design centers and manufacturing operations, EM Microelectronic operates in a global and collaborative environment, delivering high-quality, energy-efficient semiconductor solutions.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative semiconductor solutions used in automotive, medical, and IoT applications, within a globally recognized Swiss organization.
Job description
The Project Manager will be responsible for the successful planning and execution of low-power wireless System-on-Chip (SoC) development programs. The role ensures delivery from concept to production while coordinating cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
The position requires a strong focus on schedule, quality, cost, and compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
Remote or hybrid work model are not possible.
Key
• Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate SoC development programs from definition through production release
Manage project planning, including timelines, resources, budgets, and risk mitigation
Coordinate activities across engineering, product management, and operations teams
Ensure alignment across technical domains, including hardware, RF, firmware, and system integration
Lead development of wireless SOC products using low-power design techniques
Manage product compliance with RF, cybersecurity, medical and automotive standards
Provide regular status reporting and communication to internal stakeholders and management
Manage with external partners, including suppliers, IP vendors, and foundries
Profile
Knowledge of low-power wireless technologies (e.g., BLE, Thread)
Familiarity with RF concepts and product certification processes
Experience with automotive development, functional safety standards, and regulated (ie medical) environments
Familiarity with cyber security requirements of IoT and related markets
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile)
Strong organizational and coordination skills
Ability to work effectively in multicultural and distributed teams
Clear communication and stakeholder management
Proactive approach to risk identification and problem-solving
Ability to manage complex projects within defined timelines
Professional requirements
Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
5–10 years of experience in project or program management within semiconductor or embedded systems environments
Experience managing ASIC or SoC development programs
Proven ability to work with cross-functional and international teams
Good understanding of semiconductor development processes and low-power design concepts
Fluent in English (required) any other language mainly French are an asset

Rue des Sors 3
2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
Switzerland

Projektmanager – Low Power Wireless SoC Design – Swatch Group Projektmanager – Low Power Wireless SoC Design Das Unternehmen EM Microelectronic, Teil der Swatch Group, ist ein Schweizer Halbleiterunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung und Produktion von integrierten Schaltkreisen mit extrem geringem Stromverbrauch und niedriger Spannung spezialisiert hat. Seine Lösungen unterstützen eine breite Palette von Anwendungen, darunter IoT-, Verbraucher-, Industrie-, Automobil- und Medizinmärkte. Mit internationalen Designzentren und Fertigungsbetrieben agiert EM Microelectronic in einem globalen und kollaborativen Umfeld und liefert hochwertige, energieeffiziente Halbleiterlösungen. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, innerhalb einer weltweit anerkannten Schweizer Organisation zur Entwicklung innovativer Halbleiterlösungen für Automobil-, Medizin- und IoT-Anwendungen beizutragen. Stellenbeschreibung: Der Projektmanager ist für die erfolgreiche Planung und Durchführung von drahtlosen System-on-Chip (SoC)-Entwicklungsprogrammen mit geringem Stromverbrauch verantwortlich. Die Rolle stellt die Umsetzung vom Konzept bis zur Produktion sicher und koordiniert gleichzeitig funktionsübergreifende und geografisch verteilte Teams. Die Position erfordert einen starken Fokus auf Zeitplan, Qualität, Kosten und die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Regulierungsstandards. Remote- oder Hybrid-Arbeitsmodelle sind nicht möglich. Hauptaufgaben
• Führen und koordinieren Sie SoC-Entwicklungsprogramme von der Definition bis zur Produktionsfreigabe. Verwalten Sie die Projektplanung, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Ressourcen, Budgets und Risikominderung. Koordinieren Sie Aktivitäten in den Bereichen Technik, Produktmanagement und Betriebsteams. Sicherstellen Sie die Abstimmung über technische Bereiche hinweg, einschließlich Hardware, RF, Firmware und Systemintegration. Führen Sie die Entwicklung von drahtlosen SOC-Produkten unter Verwendung energiesparender Designtechniken. Verwalten Sie die Produktkonformität mit RF-, Cybersicherheits-, Medizin- und Automobilstandards. Bereitstellen Sie regelmäßige Statusberichte und Kommunikation mit internen Interessengruppen und dem Management. Verwalten Sie mit externen Partnern, einschließlich Lieferanten, IP-Anbietern und Gießereien Profil: Kenntnisse über Low-Power-Wireless-Technologien (z. B. Ses solutions prennent en charge un large éventail d'applications, notamment les marchés de l'IoT, grand public, industriel, automobile et médical. jobs.description:
Head of Global Quality - Swatch Group

Head of Global Quality
• Job description
• In order to strengthen our Quality team we are recruiting our new
• Mission :
• Responsible for overall company quality management aspects, throughout the whole supply chain and throughout products’ life cycle, for all served market segments.
• Member of the extended staff and Projects Validation Committee.
• Support EM CEO on side topics with sister companies, beyond EM role.
• This role impacts all EM sites.
• Expected end-results:
• Customers’ satisfaction.
• EM competitiveness.
• EM results
• Quality culture and organization engagement towards quality function mission.
• Tasks and responsibilities :
Ensure that EM management system fully complies with the requirements of served markets standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO17025, etc....), with TQM principles as well as with specific customers’ requirements, with regulatory / statutory requirements and with Swatch Group requirements.
Company governance: establish, upgrade, and deploy business manual, key processes approach, and adequate surveillance with boards members, in alignment with stakeholders’ expectations
Oversee, maintain and continuously improve EM Management system through regular reviews, audits, and updates. Train and support staff in QMS processes and best practices.
Own the company management review process. Ensure quality plans and company level programs derived from MR respond to EM major risks derived from evolution of EM environment (market/competition/customers/suppliers/ Swatch Group/employees/government/regulations).
• Align quality strategy and metrics with company higher level objectives and strategy.
• Define EM quality policy with key stakeholders and ensure deployment throughout all EM processes and to all levels of EM organization
• Anticipate long-term challenges, organization and market needs.
• Define, deploy, monitors and reports of quality plans to ensure effective quality organization contribution to company targets & competitiveness, customers’ satisfaction and financial profitability.
Oversee and drive EM quality performance and continuous improvement all along the supply chain (supplier quality and customer complaints), operations and development in collaboration with key stakeholders.
• Lead and manage the Product Quality Assurance team to ensure all products meet or exceed customer expectations and meet regulatory requirements.
• Ensure EM products meet regulatory requirements in all served market locations.
• Ensure that EM organization understand master quality tools and methods to carry out their mission within EM organization.
Ensure customers quality management contracts are reviewed and adapted to meet EM best interest while satisfying their requirements. Ensure suppliers’ quality management contracts are accepted to the best of EM interest and EM customers’ requirements.
Ensure quality labs meet industry best in class standard and service to EM stakeholders.
Ensure the quality department is structured and staffed to satisfy the needs of interested parties and served market segments. Drive EM team engagement and performance to provide best in class support and service to EM worldwide.
Profile
• Master in Engineering in Electronics or Microelectronics.
• > 10 years in a similar position.
• Quality Management System: in depth knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949. Knowledge of ISO17025 / 13485 / 14001. Functional safety ISO26262 knowledge is a plus.
• Automotive core tools: FMEA, MSA, SPC, PPAP, APQP.
• Relevant industry standards such as AEC Qxx, A-SPICE, relevant Jedec, ZVEI, VDA, MIL883 etc.
• Audit experience with VDA 6.3 / VDA6.5 and strong knowledge about ISO19011.
• Strong problem-solving 8D techniques and risk management / contingency / mitigation methods.
• Statistical competencies, Black Belt Six Sigma is a strong plus. Knowledge of LEAN concept is a strong plus. Project management skills is an advantage.
Strong knowledge of semiconductor technologies & products development methods, manufacturing processes/environment and related quality business processes. Strong knowledge of the IC industry, markets and players.
Professional requirements
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to influence and drive change across the organization.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Strategic thinking.
• Commitment to excellence.
• Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
• Strong leadership and team management skills.
• Team player with adequate negotiating and assertiveness skills.
• Languages
• Fluent English; French is strong advantage.
• Contact
• Denise Germann
• Job location
• Rue des Sors 3
• 2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
• Switzerland
• Company address
• EM Microelectronic-Marin Ltd
• CH-2074 Marin-Epagnier

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabile della Qualità Globale - Swatch Group Head of Global Quality
• Descrizione del lavoro
• Per rafforzare il nostro team di Qualità stiamo reclutando la nostra nuova missione:
• Responsabile per gli aspetti globali della gestione della qualità aziendale, in tutta la filiera e nel corso del ciclo di vita dei prodotti, per tutti i segmenti di mercato serviti.
• Membro del comitato di convalida dei progetti e del personale esteso.
• Sostenere l'amministratore delegato di EM su argomenti di lato con le aziende sorelle, oltre il ruolo di EM.
• Questo ruolo influisce su tutti i siti EM.
• Risultato finale previsto:
• soddisfazione dei clienti.
• competitività dell'EM.
• Risultati EM
• Cultura e impegno organizzativo di qualità verso la missione di funzioni di qualità.
• Compiti e responsabilità: Assicurarsi che il sistema di gestione EM sia pienamente conforme ai requisiti degli standard di mercato serviti (ad esempio, ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO17025, ecc....), ai principi TQM e ai requisiti specifici dei clienti, ai requisiti normativi / statutari e ai requisiti del Gruppo Swatch. Governance aziendale: stabilire, aggiornare e implementare manuale aziendale, approccio processi chiave, e una sorveglianza adeguata con i membri delle commissioni, in allineamento con le aspettative degli stakeholder supervisionare, mantenere e migliorare continuamente il sistema EM Management attraverso regolari recensioni, audit e aggiornamenti. Personale di formazione e supporto nei processi QMS e nelle migliori pratiche. Proprio il processo di revisione della gestione aziendale. Assicurare piani di qualità e programmi di livello aziendale derivati da MR rispondono ai principali rischi derivanti dall'evoluzione dell'ambiente EM (market/competition/customers/suppliers/Swatch Group/employees/government/regulations).
• Allineare la strategia di qualità e le metriche con gli obiettivi e la strategia di livello superiore dell'azienda.
• Definire la politica di qualità EM con gli stakeholder chiave e garantire la distribuzione in tutti i processi EM e a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione EM
• Anticipare le sfide a lungo termine, l'organizzazione e le esigenze di mercato.
• Definire, distribuire, monitorare e segnalare i piani di qualità per garantire un efficace contributo di organizzazione della qualità agli obiettivi aziendali e alla competitività, alla soddisfazione dei clienti e alla redditività finanziaria. Superare e guidare le prestazioni di qualità EM e il miglioramento continuo lungo la supply chain (qualità dei fornitori e reclami dei clienti), le operazioni e lo sviluppo in collaborazione con i principali stakeholder.
• Guidare e gestire il team Product Quality Assurance per garantire che tutti i prodotti soddisfino o superino le aspettative dei clienti e soddisfino i requisiti normativi.
• Assicurarsi che i prodotti EM soddisfino i requisiti normativi in tutte le sedi di mercato servite.
• Assicurarsi che l'organizzazione EM comprenda strumenti e metodi di qualità master per svolgere la loro missione all'interno dell'organizzazione EM. Assicurare ai clienti i contratti di gestione della qualità vengono riesaminati e adattati per soddisfare i migliori interessi EM e soddisfare le loro esigenze. Assicurare i contratti di gestione della qualità dei fornitori sono accettati al meglio degli interessi EM e dei requisiti dei clienti EM. Assicurarsi che i laboratori di qualità soddisfino al meglio il settore nello standard di classe e nel servizio agli stakeholder EM. Assicurarsi che il reparto di qualità sia strutturato e lavorato per soddisfare le esigenze delle parti interessate e dei segmenti di mercato serviti. Guida l'impegno e le prestazioni del team EM per fornire il meglio nel supporto e nel servizio di classe a EM in tutto il mondo. Profilo
• Master in Ingegneria in Elettronica o Microelettronica.
• > 10 anni in una posizione simile.
• Sistema di gestione della qualità: conoscenza approfondita di ISO 9001, IATF 16949. Conoscenza di ISO17025 / 13485 / 14001. La conoscenza della sicurezza funzionale ISO262 è un plus.
• Strumenti di base automobilistici: FMEA, MSA, SPC, PPAP, APQP.
• Norme di settore rilevanti come AEC Qxx, A-SPICE, pertinente Jedec, ZVEI, VDA, MIL883 ecc
• Esperienza di audit con VDA 6.3 / VDA6.5 e forte conoscenza su ISO19011.
• Forte problem solving 8D tecniche e gestione del rischio / contingenza / metodi di mitigazione.
• Competenze statistiche, Black Belt Six Sigma è un vantaggio forte. La conoscenza del concetto LEAN è un vantaggio forte. Le capacità di gestione del progetto sono un vantaggio. Forte conoscenza delle tecnologie dei semiconduttori e dei metodi di sviluppo dei prodotti, dei processi di produzione/ambiente e dei relativi processi aziendali di qualità. Forte conoscenza dell'industria IC, dei mercati e dei giocatori. Requisiti professionali
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Capacità di influenzare e guidare il cambiamento in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.

• Stellenbeschreibung
• Zur Verstärkung unseres Qualitätsteams rekrutieren wir unsere neue
• Mission:
• Verantwortlich für die gesamten Qualitätsmanagementaspekte des Unternehmens, über die gesamte Lieferkette und den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, für alle bedienten Marktsegmente.
• Mitglied des erweiterten Stabs und Projektvalidierungsausschusses.
• Unterstützung des EM-CEOs bei Nebenthemen mit Schwesterunternehmen, die über die EM-Rolle hinausgehen.
• Diese Rolle betrifft alle EM-Standorte.
• Erwartete Endergebnisse:
• Kundenzufriedenheit.
• Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der Schwellenländer.
• EM-Ergebnisse.
• Qualitätskultur und Engagement der Organisation für die Mission der Qualitätsfunktion.
• Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: Stellen Sie sicher, dass das EM-Managementsystem vollständig den Anforderungen der Standards der bedienten Märkte (z. B. ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO17025 usw.), den TQM-Grundsätzen sowie den spezifischen Kundenanforderungen, den behördlichen/gesetzlichen Anforderungen und den Anforderungen der Swatch Group entspricht. Unternehmensführung: Erstellung, Aktualisierung und Bereitstellung von Geschäftshandbüchern, Schlüsselprozessen und angemessener Überwachung durch Vorstandsmitglieder im Einklang mit den Erwartungen der Stakeholder. Überwachung, Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des EM-Managementsystems durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen, Audits und Aktualisierungen. Schulung und Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter in QMS-Prozessen und Best Practices. Verantwortlich für den Überprüfungsprozess der Unternehmensleitung. Stellen Sie sicher, dass aus der MR abgeleitete Qualitätspläne und Programme auf Unternehmensebene auf die großen EM-Risiken reagieren, die sich aus der Entwicklung des EM-Umfelds (Markt/Wettbewerb/Kunden/Lieferanten/Swatch Group/Mitarbeiter/Regierung/Vorschriften) ergeben.
• Richten Sie die Qualitätsstrategie und -kennzahlen an den übergeordneten Zielen und der Strategie des Unternehmens aus.
• Definieren Sie EM-Qualitätsrichtlinien mit wichtigen Stakeholdern und stellen Sie sicher, dass sie in allen EM-Prozessen und auf allen Ebenen der EM-Organisation umgesetzt werden.
• Langfristige Herausforderungen, Organisations- und Marktanforderungen antizipieren.
• Definieren, implementieren, überwachen und berichten Sie Qualitätspläne, um einen effektiven Beitrag der Qualitätsorganisation zu Unternehmenszielen und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Kundenzufriedenheit und finanzieller Rentabilität sicherzustellen. Überwachung und Förderung der EM-Qualitätsleistung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung entlang der gesamten Lieferkette (Lieferantenqualität und Kundenbeschwerden), Betrieb und Entwicklung in Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Interessengruppen.
• Führen und leiten Sie das Produktqualitätssicherungsteam, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Produkte die Kundenerwartungen erfüllen oder übertreffen und die gesetzlichen Anforderungen erfüllen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass EM-Produkte die gesetzlichen Anforderungen an allen bedienten Marktstandorten erfüllen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die EM-Organisation über erstklassige Qualitätswerkzeuge und -methoden verfügt, um ihre Mission innerhalb der EM-Organisation erfüllen zu können. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Qualitätsmanagementverträge der Kunden überprüft und angepasst werden, um den Interessen der EM gerecht zu werden und gleichzeitig ihre Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Qualitätsmanagementverträge der Lieferanten im besten Interesse von EM und den Anforderungen der EM-Kunden akzeptiert werden. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Qualitätslabore den Branchenstandards und Serviceleistungen für EM-Stakeholder entsprechen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Qualitätsabteilung so strukturiert und besetzt ist, dass sie den Bedürfnissen interessierter Parteien und bedienter Marktsegmente gerecht wird. Fördern Sie das Engagement und die Leistung des EM-Teams, um EM weltweit erstklassigen Support und Service zu bieten. Profil
• Master in Ingenieurwissenschaften in Elektronik oder Mikroelektronik.
• > 10 Jahre in einer ähnlichen Position.
• Qualitätsmanagementsystem: fundierte Kenntnisse von ISO 9001, IATF 16949. Kenntnisse von ISO17025 / 13485 / 14001. Kenntnisse der funktionalen Sicherheit ISO26262 sind von Vorteil.
• Automotive-Kerntools: FMEA, MSA, SPC, PPAP, APQP.

• Anticiper les défis à long terme, l'organisation et les besoins du marché.
• Définir, déployer, surveiller et rapporter les plans qualité pour garantir la contribution efficace de l'organisation qualité aux objectifs et à la compétitivité de l'entreprise, à la satisfaction des clients et à la rentabilité financière. Superviser et piloter les performances de qualité EM et l'amélioration continue tout au long de la chaîne d'approvisionnement (qualité des fournisseurs et réclamations des clients), des opérations et du développement en collaboration avec les principales parties prenantes.

Die Zugehörigkeit von Hour Passion zur Swatch Group macht uns zu einem authentischen offiziellen Händler seiner Marken und zu einem legitimen Schweizer Uhrenbotschafter. Wir freuen uns, Ihnen zu helfen, die Geschichte und das Know-how der international berüchtigten Marken jeden Tag zu entdecken.

Wir suchen erfahrene, luxuriöse Vertriebsmitarbeiter für unsere Hour Passion Boutique in Woodbury Commons Premium Outlets.
Zuständigkeiten:
· Ein einzigartiges und besonderes Erlebnis für alle Kunden
· Erfüllen und Übertreffen der Verkaufsziele
· Potenzielle Kunden sowohl durch Clientelling als auch durch Networking-Bemühungen entwickeln
· Bestehende Kunden pflegen und ausbauen; Aufzeichnungen über Meilensteine und den Geschmack und die Ziele der Kunden für zukünftige Einkäufe führen
· Unterstützung der Teammitglieder im Verkaufsprozess gemäß den etablierten Boutique-Protokollen
· Aufbau einer bestehenden Kundenbasis und Erreichung neuer Perspektiven durch Vernetzung und Kontaktaufnahme
· Bereitstellung eines überlegenen After-Sales-Service für alle Kunden
· Ein Höchstmaß an Kundenservice durch personalisierten Kontakt in der Produktwartung

jobs.title: Boutique Manager - Rado
jobs.description:
Boutique Manager - Rado - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager - Rado
• Job description
• Operation in the store/ Sales product to achieve the target
• Responsible in managing the shop under assignment.
• Responsible for daily operation of shop from customer service, staff management, stock management, brand presence through all merchandising and sales turnover.
• Conduct daily store check and stock check in-store to ensure a proper brand presence and accuracy.
• Co-ordinate with team to organize working schedule for sales staff in shop.
• Achieve a monthly sales budget.
• Ensure that a store is operated under a clean.
• Prepare all necessary Sales Reports (daily and monthly) and Stock Report (monthly), expense reimbursement, credit card slips submission, etc. to the head office.
• Efficiently operate the POS system and make sure that all sales transactions (credit card, cash, deposits) correspond to the sales turnover generated on a daily basis.
• Inventory
• Monitor and review stock level taken into consideration customer needs and trends, and advise Retail Manager of any suggestions necessary to increase sales.
• Conduct daily audit of stock management including merchandise receipt, transfers and sales.
• Manage customers’ reservations and waiting lists of unavailable products.
• Coaching to sales representative
• Staff motivation and encouragement.
• Ensure that Customer Service Officer delivers a high standard of service to all customers.
• Responsible for leading the team with a good discipline and integrity.
• Collaborate with Retail Manager to develop an internal training/ coaching programs on selling skills, product, customer service, marketing, and competitions.
• Evaluate sales performance on a daily basis and motivate sales staff as per guidelines given by Retail Manager.
• Problem solving skill with well organizational, time management, prioritization, and multitasking skills
• Able to communicate and give clear directions from back office to team and able to set expectations for their team.
• Communication
• Provide Retail Manager with reviews and updates on various issues relating to store/staff management matters.
• Discuss with Retail Manager on any suggestions relating to business issues in order to facilitate improvement in store operation.
• Marketing/ Customer Relationship Management
• Handling customer complaints effectively.
• Create as much as possible loyalty/regular customers who will eventually turn to be VIPs.
• Brain storm and support Retail Manager on any initiatives and implementations on in-store promotions and other CRM programs
• Make sure that all windows are properly displayed. Necessary change should be made to refresh the merchandise.
• Reporting
• Prepare weekly reports, monthly presentation (internal & external use).
• Perform monthly sales reports to submit to Brand Manager and HQ.
• Professional requirements
• Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in related fields.
• At least 1 years working experience in retail sales operations, and passionate in watches, preferably for a company with fast moving goods/products.
• Possess a leadership style, service minded, sales oriented and able to handle multi tasks.
• Skills: Must have
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Excellent command of English. Any other language an asset.
• Strong sales and negotiation skills.
• Ability to understand and present technical details.
• Proficient in using POS systems and handling transactions.
• Computer literacy and knowledge of Microsoft Office software.
• Job location
• 87 Wireless Road
• 10330 Bangkok (Bangkok)
• Thailand
• Company address
• The Swatch Group Trading (Thailand) Limited
• 4th Floor, M. Thai Tower, All Seasons Place
• Pathumwan District
• TH-Bangkok 10330

Boutique Manager - Rado - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager - Rado
• Descrizione del lavoro
• Funzionamento in negozio / prodotto di vendita per raggiungere l'obiettivo
• Responsabile nella gestione del negozio in assegnazione.
• Responsabile per il funzionamento quotidiano di negozio dal servizio clienti, gestione del personale, gestione delle scorte, presenza del marchio attraverso tutti i merchandising e fatturato di vendita.
• Condurre il controllo giornaliero del negozio e il controllo delle scorte in-store per garantire una corretta presenza e precisione del marchio.
• Coordinate con il team per organizzare il programma di lavoro per il personale di vendita in negozio.
• Ottenere un bilancio mensile di vendita.
• Assicurarsi che un negozio sia gestito in modo pulito.
• Preparare tutte le necessarie relazioni di vendita (giornali e mensili) e la relazione d'archivio (mese), il rimborso delle spese, la presentazione delle carte di credito, ecc. alla sede centrale.
• Efficientemente operare il sistema POS e assicurarsi che tutte le transazioni di vendita (carta di credito, contanti, depositi) corrispondano al fatturato di vendita generato quotidianamente.
• Inventario
• Monitorare e rivedere il livello azionario preso in considerazione le esigenze e le tendenze del cliente, e consigliare Retail Manager di eventuali suggerimenti necessari per aumentare le vendite.
• Condurre il controllo giornaliero della gestione delle scorte, tra cui la ricevuta della merce, i trasferimenti e le vendite.
• Gestire le prenotazioni dei clienti e le liste di attesa dei prodotti non disponibili.
• Coaching al rappresentante di vendita
• Motivazione e incoraggiamento del personale.
• Assicurarsi che il Customer Service Officer fornisca un elevato standard di servizio a tutti i clienti.
• Responsabile per guidare il team con una buona disciplina e integrità.
• Collaborare con Retail Manager per sviluppare programmi di formazione interna / coaching su competenze di vendita, prodotto, servizio clienti, marketing e concorsi.
• Valutare le prestazioni di vendita ogni giorno e motivare il personale di vendita secondo le linee guida fornite da Retail Manager.
• Abilità di problem solving con ben organizzati, gestione del tempo, priorità e competenze multitasking
• In grado di comunicare e dare indicazioni chiare dal back office al team e in grado di impostare le aspettative per il loro team.
• Comunicazione
• Fornire Retail Manager con recensioni e aggiornamenti su vari problemi relativi a questioni di gestione negozio/staff.
• Discutere con Retail Manager su eventuali suggerimenti relativi alle questioni aziendali al fine di facilitare il miglioramento del funzionamento del negozio.
• Marketing / Gestione delle relazioni con i clienti
• Gestione efficace dei reclami dei clienti.
• Creare il più possibile fedeltà / clienti regolari che alla fine si trasformerà in VIP.
• Tempesta del cervello e supporto Retail Manager su eventuali iniziative e implementazioni su promozioni in-store e altri programmi CRM
• Assicurarsi che tutte le finestre siano visualizzate correttamente. Il cambiamento necessario deve essere fatto per aggiornare la merce.
• Rapporti
• Preparare relazioni settimanali, presentazione mensile (uso interno ed esterno).
• Eseguire rapporti di vendita mensili per inviare a Brand Manager e HQ.
• Requisiti professionali
• Qualifiche
• Laurea o superiore in campi correlati.
• Almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa nelle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, e appassionato di orologi, preferibilmente per un'azienda con prodotti / prodotti in movimento veloce.
• Possede uno stile di leadership, un servizio pensato, orientato alle vendite e in grado di gestire più compiti.

• Ottimo comando dell'inglese. Qualsiasi altra lingua un bene.

Boutique Manager - Rado - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager - Rado
• Stellenbeschreibung
• Betrieb im Laden / Verkaufsprodukt, um das Ziel zu erreichen
• Verantwortlich für die Verwaltung des Shops unter Zuweisung.
• Verantwortlich für den täglichen Betrieb des Shops vom Kundenservice, Personalmanagement, Lagerverwaltung, Markenauftritt bis hin zum gesamten Merchandising und Umsatz.
• Führen Sie täglich Laden- und Lagerprüfungen im Laden durch, um eine angemessene Markenpräsenz und -genauigkeit zu gewährleisten.
• Koordinieren Sie sich mit dem Team, um den Arbeitsplan für das Verkaufspersonal im Geschäft zu organisieren.
• Erreichen Sie ein monatliches Verkaufsbudget.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass ein Geschäft unter einem sauberen betrieben wird.
• Bereiten Sie alle notwendigen Verkaufsberichte (täglich und monatlich) und Bestandsbericht (monatlich), Kostenerstattung, Kreditkarteneinreichung usw. an die Zentrale vor.
• Betreiben Sie das Kassensystem effizient und stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Verkaufstransaktionen (Kreditkarte, Bargeld, Einlagen) dem täglich generierten Umsatz entsprechen.
• Inventar
• Überwachung und Überprüfung des Lagerbestands unter Berücksichtigung der Kundenbedürfnisse und -trends und Beratung des Retail Managers über alle Vorschläge, die zur Steigerung des Umsatzes erforderlich sind.
• Durchführung täglicher Audits der Bestandsverwaltung einschließlich Wareneingang, Transfers und Verkäufen.
• Verwalten Sie die Reservierungen der Kunden und Wartelisten von nicht verfügbaren Produkten.
• Coaching zum Vertriebsmitarbeiter
• Motivation und Ermutigung des Personals.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Customer Service Officer allen Kunden einen hohen Servicestandard bietet.
• Verantwortlich für die Führung des Teams mit einer guten Disziplin und Integrität.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Retail Manager zusammen, um ein internes Training / Coaching-Programm zum Verkauf von Fähigkeiten, Produkten, Kundenservice, Marketing und Wettbewerben zu entwickeln.
• Bewerten Sie die Verkaufsleistung täglich und motivieren Sie das Verkaufspersonal gemäß den Richtlinien des Retail Managers.
• Problemlösung mit gut organisatorischen, Zeitmanagement, Priorisierung und Multitasking-Fähigkeiten
• In der Lage zu kommunizieren und klare Anweisungen vom Backoffice zum Team zu geben und Erwartungen für ihr Team zu setzen.
• Kommunikation
• Geben Sie Retail Manager mit Bewertungen und Updates zu verschiedenen Fragen im Zusammenhang mit Geschäft / Personalmanagement Fragen.
• Diskutieren Sie mit dem Retail Manager über Vorschläge zu Geschäftsfragen, um die Verbesserung des Ladenbetriebs zu erleichtern.
• Marketing/ Customer Relationship Management
• Kundenbeschwerden effektiv bearbeiten.
• Schaffen Sie so viel wie möglich Loyalität / normale Kunden, die schließlich VIPs werden.
• Brain Storm und Unterstützung des Retail Managers bei allen Initiativen und Implementierungen von In-Store-Promotions und anderen CRM-Programmen
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Fenster ordnungsgemäß angezeigt werden. Notwendige Änderungen sollten vorgenommen werden, um die Ware aufzufrischen.
• Berichterstattung
• Erstellen Sie wöchentliche Berichte, monatliche Präsentation (interne & externe Nutzung).
• Führen Sie monatliche Verkaufsberichte durch, um sie an Brand Manager und HQ zu übermitteln.
• Berufliche Anforderungen
• Qualifikationen
• Bachelor-Abschluss oder höher in verwandten Bereichen.
• Mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung im Einzelhandel und leidenschaftlich in Uhren, vorzugsweise für ein Unternehmen mit schnelllebigen Waren / Produkten.
• Besitzen Sie einen Führungsstil, serviceorientiert, vertriebsorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Aufgaben zu bewältigen.
• Fähigkeiten: Muss haben
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.
• Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse. Jede andere Sprache ist ein Asset.
• Starke Verkaufs- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.
• Fähigkeit, technische Details zu verstehen und darzustellen.
• Proficient in der Verwendung von POS-Systemen und Abwicklung von Transaktionen.
• Computerkenntnisse und Kenntnisse der Microsoft Office-Software.

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - SouthPark (NC) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - SouthPark (NC)
The company

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Dallas - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Dallas
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.

jobs.description:
Customer Service Specialist - Swatch Group

Customer Service Specialist
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc. is looking for a self-motivated and energetic individual with a passion for providing excellent Customer Service and support to our various watch brands such as Omega, Tissot, Longines, Hamilton, and Swatch. This is not your traditional high volume call center environment. This position varies and involves working with Clients, Sales Representatives, and End-consumers.
Profile
Duties and Responsibilities
- Answer all customer inquiries including general information and pricing on the products
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Provide support to our brands and re-sellers
- Utilize company resources for product knowledge and proactive approach to constant refreshing of latest product offerings.
- Responds timely to email inquiries and facilitate departmental deadlines and goals.
- Assist customers by answering phone calls, placing product order and providing shipping status
- Research and respond to customer inquiries in person, phone and e-mail.
- Review and update customer records on computerized data base, SAP system.
- Resolve problems through partnerships with appropriate parties/department heads.
- Research timepieces and parts in the SAP.
- Assure the highest level of customer satisfaction including timely and adequate follow up process.
- Perform due diligence on customer inquiries through oral and written communication.
- Assist in providing initial training to new agents as and when required.
- All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED is required
- Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Office.
- Previous experience or Knowledge of SAP System is a plus
- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.
- Must be highly organized with superior follow-up skills.
- Must be flexibility to work additional hours during peak season.
- Must be a dependable and reliable team player.
- Must be able to work well in fast-paced environment
- Must have the ability to learn new tasks as needed for upward growth (team and individual)
Physical Requirements
This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Customer Service Specialist to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
It would be a huge plus if you have following work experiences: Customer Service Representative, Customer Service Associate, Customer Service Assistant, Customer Service Coordinator, and Customer Service Agent.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Customer Service Specialist duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Kundendienst Spezialist - Swatch Group

Kundendienst Spezialist
Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Job Description
Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc. ist auf der Suche nach einem selbstmotivierten und energetischen Individuum mit einer Leidenschaft für exzellenten Kundenservice und Unterstützung unserer verschiedenen Uhrenmarken wie Omega, Tissot, Longines, Hamilton und Swatch. Dies ist nicht Ihre traditionelle hohe Lautstärke Call Center Umgebung. Diese Position variiert und beinhaltet die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Vertriebsvertretern und Endverbrauchern.
Profil
Pflichten und Pflichten
- Beantworten Sie alle Kundenanfragen einschließlich allgemeine Informationen und Preise für die Produkte
- Verwenden Sie Produktwissen und Auswahl, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
- Unterstützung für unsere Marken und Wiederverkäufer
- Verwenden Sie Unternehmensressourcen für Produktwissen und proaktiven Ansatz zur ständigen Erfrischung der neuesten Produktangebote.
- Beantwortet zeitnah E-Mail-Anfragen und erleichtert Dienstzeiten und Ziele.
- Assist Kunden durch Anrufbeantwortung, Produktauftrag und Lieferstatus
- Forschung und Reaktion auf Kundenanfragen in Person, Telefon und E-Mail.
- Überprüfen und aktualisieren Sie die Kundendaten auf der computergestützten Datenbank, SAP-System.
- Probleme durch Partnerschaften mit entsprechenden Parteien/Abteilungsleitern lösen.
- Forschungszeitstücke und Teile im SAP.
- Sicherstellung der höchsten Kundenzufriedenheit einschließlich rechtzeitiger und angemessener Folgeprozesse.
- Führen Sie Due Diligence auf Kundenanfragen durch mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation durch.
- Es besteht die Aufgabe, neue Agenten nach und nach zu trainieren.
- Alle anderen Aufgaben von Management
Anforderungen
Anforderungen an Bildung und Erfahrung
- High School Diploma oder GED erforderlich
- Muss ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.
- Muss in Microsoft Office proficient sein.
- Vorherige Erfahrung oder Wissen von SAP System ist ein Plus
- Fähigkeit, unter Druck zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eine hohe Genauigkeit und Organisation zu erhalten.
- Muss hoch organisiert werden mit überlegenen Nachfolgefähigkeiten.
- Muss Flexibilität sein, zusätzliche Stunden während der Hochsaison zu arbeiten.
- Muss ein zuverlässiger und zuverlässiger Teamplayer sein.
- Muss in schnelllebiger Umgebung gut funktionieren können
- Muss die Fähigkeit haben, neue Aufgaben zu erlernen, die für das Aufwärtswachstum benötigt werden (team und individuell)
Allgemeine Anforderungen
Dies ist in erster Linie eine sedentäre Büroposition, die der Kundendienst Spezialist benötigt, um die Fähigkeit zu haben, Computer-Ausrüstung zu betreiben, zu sprechen, zu hören, zu biegen, zu erreichen, zu heben und zu bewegen und bis zu 25 lbs. Fingerabschreckung ist notwendig.
Es wäre ein großes Plus, wenn Sie folgende Arbeitserfahrungen haben: Customer Service Representative, Customer Service Associate, Customer Service Assistant, Customer Service Coordinator und Customer Service Agent.
Diese Beschreibung beschreibt die grundlegenden Aufgaben und Anforderungen für die Rolle. Dies ist keine umfassende Auflistung aller Aufgaben der Kundendienstspezialisten, Verantwortlichkeiten und Aktivitäten können sich jederzeit mit oder ohne Ankündigung ändern.

Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet.

Toutes les autres fonctions assignées par les exigences en matière de gestion
• Exigences en matière d'éducation et d'expérience - Diplôme d'études secondaires ou DEG - Doit posséder d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite. - Il doit être compétent en Microsoft Office. - Expérience antérieure ou connaissance du système SAP est un plus - Capacité à multitâcher et travailler sous pression tout en maintenant un niveau élevé de précision et d'organisation. - Doit être hautement organisé avec des compétences supérieures de suivi. - Doit être flexible pour travailler des heures supplémentaires pendant la haute saison. - Doit être un joueur fiable et fiable. - Doit être capable de bien fonctionner dans un environnement à rythme rapide - Doit avoir la capacité d'apprendre de nouvelles tâches selon les besoins pour la croissance à la hausse (équipe et individuelle) Il s'agit principalement d'un poste de bureau sédentaire qui exige que le spécialiste du service à la clientèle ait la capacité d'utiliser l'équipement informatique, de parler, d'entendre, de plier, de s'abaisser, d'atteindre, de soulever et de transporter jusqu'à 25 livres. jobs.title: Sales Associate (Robson Street)
jobs.description:
Sales Associate (Robson Street) - Swatch Group

Sales Associate (Robson Street)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Associate, you will report to the Store Manager and be responsible for achieving sales targets. You will act as a Swatch Brand Ambassador while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.
Starting base pay of $18.30 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Deliver exceptional customer service by assisting customers and resolving issues with a positive attitude. Achieve and exceed sales targets though outstanding product knowledge.
• Operations: Support daily operations, including processing sales and returns, inventory management, and adhering to operation policies and procedures.
• Visual Merchandising: Assist in maintaining store’s visual standards by following visual merchandising guidelines. Assists in maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the store.
• Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards.
• Working Conditions:
Part-Time, 10-15 or more hours per week on average. Part-Time employees must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 15 hours a week, certain holidays and blackout dates.
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 1 year of retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Experience working with POS systems.

Boutique Manager Luxury - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager Luxury
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Job description
We are looking for a position as Boutique Manager in one of our luxury stores in El Corte Inglés Madrid.
As a Butique Manager your main tasks will be:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Profile
The ideal candidate should be an experienced luxury retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills.
Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to detail.
The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus.
Professional requirements
Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Boutique needs.

jobs.title: Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Hours Per Week)
jobs.description:
Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Hours Per Week) - Swatch Group

Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Hours Per Week)
The company
The story of Swatch is the story of a revolution. In 1983, the unexpected appearance of an affordable, Swiss made, plastic watch turned the watch world upside down. Suddenly, a watch was much more than a way to measure time. It was a new language, a way to speak from the heart without words.
Working for Swatch you will be part of a strong and expanding retail network and working for the world’s largest watchmaking group for one of the world’s most popular brands.
Job description
Sales
Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other products.
Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
Help display merchandise as directed.
Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Store.
Security
Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency.
Care of the Store
Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
Health and Safety aware.
Good Visual Merchandising standards.
Communication
Adhere to company policies and regulations.
Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
Be familiar with international customers customs and culture.
Product Knowledge
Attend regular training days.
Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
Profile

descriptionByLocale.en:
Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Hours Per Week) - Swatch Group

Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Hours Per Week)
The company
The story of Swatch is the story of a revolution. In 1983, the unexpected appearance of an affordable, Swiss made, plastic watch turned the watch world upside down. Suddenly, a watch was much more than a way to measure time. It was a new language, a way to speak from the heart without words.
Working for Swatch you will be part of a strong and expanding retail network and working for the world’s largest watchmaking group for one of the world’s most popular brands.
Job description
Sales
Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other products.
Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
Help display merchandise as directed.
Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Store.
Security
Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency.
Care of the Store
Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
Health and Safety aware.
Good Visual Merchandising standards.
Communication
Adhere to company policies and regulations.
Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
Be familiar with international customers customs and culture.
Product Knowledge
Attend regular training days.
Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
Profile
Essential
• Positive and outgoing with the ability to naturally converse with customers
• Passionate about providing exceptional customer service, committed to understanding a customer’s needs/expectations with a strong desire to exceed them
• Adaptable with the ability to build strong working relationships within small teams
• Excited to learn about Swatch products and gain a technical understanding of our ranges
Preferred
• Have experience within retail and/or fashion accessories
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for events etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers
• Ability to communicate in multiple languages
• Commercial focus with a desire to exceed KPIs
