Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 ore per settimana)
L'azienda
La storia di Swatch è la storia di una rivoluzione. Nel 1983, l'aspetto inaspettato di un orologio svizzero, fatto a prezzi accessibili, ha rovesciato il mondo dell'orologio. Improvvisamente, un orologio era molto più di un modo per misurare il tempo. Era una nuova lingua, un modo per parlare dal cuore senza parole.
Lavorare per Swatch sarà parte di una forte e in espansione rete di vendita al dettaglio e lavorare per il più grande gruppo orologiero del mondo per uno dei marchi più popolari del mondo.
Descrizione del lavoro
Vendite
Salutare e servire tutti i clienti che forniscono un servizio amichevole e fornire un'esperienza completa e memorabile.
Assicurare familiarità con la gamma di prodotti, passato e presente, in modo che i clienti possono essere forniti con tanto dettaglio quanto necessario.
Assicurare una buona conoscenza di tutte le funzioni di orologi e altri prodotti.
Fornire informazioni affidabili ai clienti in tutte le questioni relative alle vendite e al servizio clienti.
Aiuta a visualizzare la merce come indicato.
Contribuisci al negozio raggiungendo i suoi obiettivi di vendita mensili, trimestrali e annuali.
Fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale a ogni cliente, ogni volta. Sia via e-mail, al telefono, o di persona nel negozio.
Sicurezza
Assistere nel controllo del restringimento da un'azione attenta sul pavimento del negozio, la manipolazione delle merci, la prevenzione degli incidenti e il funzionamento attento delle politiche e delle procedure di fino e amministrazione.
Mantenere/costruire una consapevolezza generale dei prodotti e dei punti caldi di sicurezza.
Seguire la politica aziendale e le procedure per l'apertura/chiusura del negozio.
Mantenere il corretto trattamento di tutte le consegne.
Gestione del denaro / operazioni di pagamento
Tutte le transazioni da gestire in modo responsabile e sicuro.
Fino a funzioni, incassamento, pagamenti e dazi generali.
Trattare, e gestire, contanti, carte di credito e valuta internazionale.
Cura del negozio
Assicurarsi che il negozio è tenuto pulito e presentabile in ogni momento.
Il retro della casa e il piano del negozio sono entrambi altrettanto importanti.
Salute e sicurezza.
Buoni standard di Visual Merchandising.
Comunicazione
Aderire alle politiche e ai regolamenti aziendali.
Partecipa a sessioni di briefing come diretto dal tuo direttore di linea.
Presentati e conduci in modo professionale sia ai clienti che ai colleghi, assicurando che tutta la comunicazione sia chiara.
Conoscere i clienti internazionali costumi e cultura.

Essere in grado di fornire una buona conoscenza del prodotto ai nostri clienti.
Altri
Svolgere tutti i doveri e le responsabilità che possono rientrare nell'impegno di un tale post sotto la direzione del vostro direttore di linea.

Essenziale
• Positivo e in uscita con la capacità di conversare naturalmente con i clienti
• Appassionato a fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale, impegnato a comprendere le esigenze/aspettative del cliente con un forte desiderio di superarle
• Adattabile con la capacità di costruire forti rapporti di lavoro all'interno di piccole squadre

Part Time Retail Sales Advisor - Swatch Birmingham (12 Stunden pro Woche)
Das Unternehmen
Die Geschichte von Swatch ist die Geschichte einer Revolution. 1983 drehte die unerwartete Erscheinung einer erschwinglichen, Schweizer, Plastikuhr die Uhrenwelt auf den Kopf. Plötzlich war eine Uhr viel mehr als ein Weg, um Zeit zu messen. Es war eine neue Sprache, ein Weg, ohne Worte vom Herzen zu sprechen.
Arbeiten für Swatch werden Sie Teil eines starken und expandierenden Einzelhandelsnetzwerks sein und für die weltweit größte Uhrengruppe für eine der weltweit beliebtesten Marken arbeiten.
Jobbeschreibung
Verkäufe
Greet und dienen allen Kunden, die einen freundlichen Service bieten und eine volle und unvergessliche Erfahrung liefern.
Stellen Sie die Vertrautheit mit dem Produktsortiment, Vergangenheit und Gegenwart sicher, so dass Kunden möglichst detailliert zur Verfügung gestellt werden können.
Vergewissern Sie sich über alle Funktionen von Uhren und anderen Produkten.
Liefern Sie zuverlässige Informationen für Kunden in allen Fragen rund um den Vertrieb und den Kundenservice.
Hilfe Anzeige Waren wie gerichtet.
Tragen Sie das Geschäft mit seinen monatlichen, vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Umsatzzielen bei.
Liefern Sie außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice für jeden Kunden, jedes Mal. Ob per E-Mail, per Telefon oder persönlich im Store.
Sicherheit
Besteht bei der Bekämpfung von Schrumpfung durch aufmerksame Maßnahmen auf dem Ladenboden, Merchandise-Handling, Unfallverhütung und sorgfältigen Betrieb der Boden- und Verwaltungspolitiken und -verfahren.
Bewahren Sie ein allgemeines Bewusstsein für Produkte und Sicherheit Hot Spots.
Folgen Sie der Unternehmenspolitik und den Verfahren für die Eröffnung/Verschluss des Ladens.
Bewahren Sie die korrekte Verarbeitung aller Lieferungen.
Cash Handling/Payment Transaktionen
Alle Transaktionen sind verantwortungsvoll und sicher zu handhaben.
Till-Funktionen, Kassierung, Zahlungen und allgemeine Aufgaben.
Umgang mit Bargeld, Kreditkarten und internationale Währung.
Pflege des Stores
Vergewissern Sie sich, dass der Laden jederzeit sauber und präsentabel gehalten wird.
Back of House und Shop Floor sind beide genauso wichtig.
Gesundheit und Sicherheit bewusst.
Gute Visual Merchandising Standards.
Kommunikation
Bleiben Sie bei den Richtlinien und Vorschriften der Gesellschaft.
Besuchen Sie die Sitzungen, die von Ihrem Leitungsmanager geleitet werden.
Präsentieren und leiten Sie sich professionell sowohl Kunden als auch Kollegen vor, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Kommunikation klar ist.
Seien Sie mit internationalen Kunden Zoll und Kultur vertraut.
Produktwissen
Besuchen Sie regelmäßige Trainingstage.
Verantwortung übernehmen und selbst motiviert und proaktiv sein, um alle neuen Produkte zu verstehen und Schulungen und Anleitungen anzuwenden.
Wir können unseren Kunden gutes Produktwissen liefern.
Sonstige
Alle Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten, die unter der Leitung Ihres Leitungsmanagers in die Zuständigkeit eines solchen Posts fallen können, übernehmen.
Profil
Wesentlich
• Positiv und ausgehend mit der Fähigkeit, natürlich mit Kunden zu konversieren
• Leidenschaftlich über die Bereitstellung von außergewöhnlichem Kundenservice, verpflichtet, die Bedürfnisse und Erwartungen eines Kunden mit einem starken Wunsch zu verstehen, sie zu übertreffen
• Anpassung an die Fähigkeit, starke Arbeitsbeziehungen in kleinen Teams aufzubauen

L'histoire de Swatch est l'histoire d'une révolution. En 1983, l'apparition inattendue d'une montre en plastique à prix abordable fabriquée par les Suisses a renversé le monde horloger. Suivez la politique et les procédures de l'entreprise pour ouvrir/fermer le magasin.
Maintenir le traitement correct de toutes les livraisons.
Traitement de la trésorerie/opérations de paiement
Toutes les transactions doivent être traitées de manière responsable et sûre.
Jusqu'aux fonctions, encaissement, paiements et tâches générales.
Traiter et gérer les espèces, les cartes de crédit et la monnaie internationale.
Entretien du magasin
Assurez-vous que le magasin est toujours propre et présentable.
L'arrière de la maison et de l'atelier sont tout aussi importants.
Santé et sécurité au courant.
Bonnes normes de marchandisation visuelle.

Assister à des séances d'information selon les directives de votre gestionnaire hiérarchique.
Présentez-vous et conduisez-vous de manière professionnelle à la fois aux clients et aux collègues, en veillant à ce que toute communication soit claire.
Connaissance des coutumes et de la culture des clients internationaux.
Connaissance des produits
Assister à des journées d'entraînement régulières.
Prendre la responsabilité, être automotivé et proactif, pour comprendre tous les nouveaux produits et appliquer la formation et les instructions.
Être en mesure de fournir une bonne connaissance des produits à nos clients.
Autres
Entreprendre toutes les tâches et responsabilités qui peuvent relever de la compétence d'un tel poste sous la direction de votre gestionnaire hiérarchique.
Profil

• Positif et sortant avec la capacité de converser naturellement avec les clients
• Passionné de fournir un service client exceptionnel, engagé à comprendre les besoins/attentes d'un client avec une forte volonté de les dépasser
• Adaptable avec la capacité d'établir de solides relations de travail au sein de petites équipes

jobs.description:
HR Generalist - Swatch Group

HR Generalist
Job description
Le/la Généraliste RH joue principalement le rôle de support et d’interface pour le département RH et les collaborateurs de l’entreprise. Il/elle s’occupe principalement de la gestion administrative et opérationnelle du personnel.
• Préparation et traitement des salaires, primes et bonus
• Etablissement et contrôle des décomptes (AVS, allocations, impôts à la source)
• Gestion des assurance sociales et de la caisse de pension
• Elaboration des budgets RH et tableaux des révisions salariales
• Bouclement annuel des comptes RH
• Préparation des statistiques et cockpit et reporting pour le groupe
• Gestion et suivi du cycle de vie du dossier du collaborateur (entrées, mutations, sorties)
• Gestion des temps (Mobatime)
• Demandes de permis
• Traitement et suivi des déclarations d’accidents et des longs cas maladie
• Support pour l’organisation d’évènements, manifestations et actions sociales pour les collaborateurs
• Rédaction des certificats de travail en Français et en Anglais
• Diverses tâches administratives RH : jubilaires, lunettes, etc…
• Participation active à la mise à jour, au maintien et à l’optimisation des processus RH
• Rédaction et publication des communications internes en Français et en Anglais
• Profile
• Formation CFC “Employé(e) de Commerce » et Certificat RH.
• Min. 3 ans d’expérience dans une fonction similaire
• Expérience Paie et gestion des temps indispensable
• Grande affinité SIRH, automation et Excel
• Maîtrise des outils informatique Office, SIRH (Proconcept, Mobatime) ERP (Navision)
• Professional requirements
Fiable, consciencieux, efficacité organisationnelle, rigueur, flexibilité, autonomie, sens des responsabilités, discrétion, collaboration, orientation client, orientation solution, initative et collaboration

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Keyholder/Watch Technician - San Antonio (La Cantera)
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
Ideal candidate will have luxury retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder or supervisory background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeanor that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our prestigious timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
This role is expected to possibly transition in to a boutique technician position, which will provide technical services to all timepieces and accessories. Dexterity and technical aptitude are highly desirable. As a technician in training Omega offers courses where you will delve into the world of timepiece mechanics and repair. Watchmaking is a highly desirable skill for this position.
Profile
• Perform opening and/ or closing Boutique procedures
• Will liaise with Store Manager and Assistant Manager and demonstrate leadership capabilities in their absence and while on the sales floor with entire team.
• Demonstrate a deep knowledge of all of our unique and impeccable range of products and their distinctive characteristics
• Cultivate enduring relationships with clients by providing memorable experiences which enlighten and provide insights into the ancestry of OMEGA
• Utilize our expansive training techniques to engage, inform and retain a gratified and loyal client base.
• Professional requirements
• Minimum 3 years of Luxury retail Sales/Keyholder experience, preferably in the timepiece or fine jewelry field.
• Watchmakers are highly desired.
• Demonstrates leadership qualities in as much as representing the Manager’s vision at all times and ensures that policies and procedures are upheld at all times.
• impressive selling capabilities and notable customer service skills
• Elevated ability to communicate effectively both written and orally
• Robust adaptability to learn the technical aspects of our company collection of timepieces
• Ability and willingness to train others in various areas of the business
• Talented negotiation prowess
• Passion for the art of selling
• Must be able to work flexible schedule throughout the week

L'azienda
OMEGA è una società del Gruppo Swatch, leader mondiale nella produzione di orologi. Dal 1848, il marchio è sinonimo di eccellenza, innovazione, design e precisione. Grazie al suo spirito pionieristico, OMEGA è stato il primo orologio indossato sulla luna, e ha goduto di molti altri risultati e esplorazioni nell'oceano e nello spazio. I suoi orologi da donna sono stati tra i più ammirati e ingegnosi del settore e, più recentemente, la reputazione di OMEGA è stata potenziata dai suoi successi nell’orologeria antimagnetica e dai suoi orologi certificati Master Chronometer, il più alto standard del settore per la precisione e le prestazioni. OMEGA è il Timekeeper ufficiale di 30 Giochi Olimpici dal 1932 ed è anche un nome leader nel campo del golf, nuoto, atletica, bobsleigh e vela. I partenariati con cause sociali includono Orbis International e il suo Flying Eye Hospital, così come la GoodPlanet Foundation. Oggi, la famiglia di ambasciatori di marca di OMEGA comprende James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin e molti altri.
Descrizione del lavoro
Il candidato ideale avrà un'esperienza di vendita al dettaglio di lusso, così come Keyholder o background di supervisione. Questa posizione deve possedere eccezionali capacità di servizio al cliente e un demeanor che incarna un grande senso di avvicinabilità. Il candidato dovrebbe anche avere la capacità di soddisfare o superare gli obiettivi di vendita e possedere un forte desiderio di conoscere i nostri orologi prestigiosi e cercando di diventare un membro essenziale del nostro team
Questo ruolo è previsto per passare eventualmente in una posizione di tecnico boutique, che fornirà servizi tecnici a tutti i orologi e accessori. La destrezza e l'attitudine tecnica sono altamente desiderabili. Come tecnico nella formazione Omega offre corsi in cui si immergerà nel mondo della meccanica orologiera e riparazione. • Utilizzare le nostre tecniche di formazione ampliate per coinvolgere, informare e mantenere una base clienti gratificata e leale.

• Minimo 3 anni di vendite al dettaglio di lusso / esperienza del portachiavi, preferibilmente nel campo del segnatempo o gioielli fini.

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Galleria (Houston, TX) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Galleria (Houston, TX)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components. Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
The Swatch brand embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Ideal candidate will have retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeaner that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
Profile
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Handle multi-tasking with ease
• Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
• Compensation: Base Pay plus commission
Professional requirements
• 2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
• Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
• Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
• Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to plan, set and achieve goals
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer the following benefits to our part-time positions:
• Excellent health insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)

Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. jobs.title: Sales Consultant
jobs.description:
Sales Consultant - Swatch Group

Sales Consultant
• The company
• About Omega
Founded in 1848, OMEGA is a watch brand renowned for its excellence, innovation, and precision. Guided by a pioneering spirit, OMEGA has explored the depths of the ocean and the vastness of space, becoming the first watch worn on the moon. Its women’s timepieces are celebrated for their elegance and creativity, while advancements in anti-magnetic technology and Master Chronometer certification continue to set new standards for performance and accuracy. As the Official Timekeeper of the Olympic Games since 1932, OMEGA is also a trusted name in world sports including golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh, and sailing. Beyond its achievements in timekeeping, OMEGA supports global initiatives through partnerships with Orbis International and the GoodPlanet Foundation, and its distinguished ambassadors include George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, and many more.
Job description
• What You'll Be Doing
• Client Engagement & Sales
• Greet every client warmly, acknowledging their presence promptly upon entering the boutique.
• Understand client preferences through attentive listening and thoughtful conversation.
• Share the unique stories behind our timepieces, highlighting features, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Meet and exceed individual sales goals while contributing to overall boutique performance.
• Take pride in presenting the right product for each client, offering recommendations that are both relevant and inspiring.
• Client Relationship Management (CRM)
• Cultivate long-term relationships with clients by maintaining regular, thoughtful follow-ups and exclusive invitations to events or launches.
• Manage and grow an active client book through CRM tools and clienteling best practices.
• Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when serving high-profile and international clientele.
• Brand & Product Knowledge
• Maintain deep product knowledge across collections and novelties, including movements, materials, and craftsmanship.
• Stay updated on brand history, key milestones, and current campaigns to support brand storytelling.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
• Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
• Uphold company procedures and policies related to operation, customer service, security and compliance.
• Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces.
• Monitor competitors’ marketing activities and provide regular market intelligence to the Management.
• Work closely with your team to create a supportive, positive environment
• Profile
• Minimum 2 years of sales experience in luxury, premium retail, or lifestyle brands.
• Passionate about client service and delivering exceptional experiences.
• Professional, well-groomed, and confident in engaging with diverse clientele.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.

jobs.description:
Retail Controller - Swatch Group

Retail Controller
Bedrijfsintroductie
Als onderdeel van het wereldwijde concern Swatch Group is The Swatch Group Netherlands de verkooporganisatie van de gerenommeerde Zwitserse horlogemerken zoals Swatch, Omega, Longines, Tissot, Hamilton, Certina, Rado en Balmain binnen Nederland.
Vanuit het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven leveren wij aan zelfstandige juweliers en grootwinkelbedrijven. Daarnaast heeft The Swatch Group Netherlands een groeiend aantal eigen verkooppunten, zoals Swatch Stores, een Tissot boutique in Amsterdam en een Hour Passion winkel in de Designer Outlet in Roermond.
• Voor het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een:
• Retail Controller (fulltime)
• Functie
Dol op cijfers? En zie je het als een sport om processen en transacties kloppend te maken én te houden? Als retail controller ben je verantwoordelijk voor álles wat met de financiële kant van de eigen winkels van The Swatch Group te maken heeft. Van controlling, administratie en voorraad tot audits en winkelopeningen. Jij draagt een volledige p&l- en balans-verantwoordelijkheid. Zin om jouw stempel te drukken op een internationale organisatie vol topmerken zoals Swatch, Omega en Tissot? Bouw samen mee aan ons succes!
Hoe ziet deze functie eruit?
Binnen deze functie ben jij hét financiële aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met retail te maken heeft. Of het nu gaat om de dagelijkse transacties in de winkels of de rapportages richting het Zwitserse hoofdkantoor: jij houdt het overzicht en de inhoud scherp. Brutomarges, kostenstructuren, CapEx-uitgaven en salesreconciliaties – alles komt voorbij.
De betrouwbaarheid van cijfers? Die staat natuurlijk voorop. Daarom controleer je bankafstemmingen en bewaak je de aansluiting tussen het POS-systeem en het ERP-systeem (SAP). Periodiek lever je scherpe inzichten aan het management, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Bij elke nieuwe winkelopening schuif je ook aan als vaste kracht binnen het operationele projectteam. Je beoordeelt prijsstellingen, werkt businesscases uit en houdt budgetten strak in de gaten. Inventory controlling? Volledig jouw terrein.
Maar daar blijft het niet bij. Regelmatig ben je onderweg. Om winkels te bezoeken voor audits op locatie. Hier toets je de naleving van interne procedures. En je telt de voorraad om juistheid en volledigheid te garanderen. Door jouw werk draait de retailorganisatie financieel als een Zwitsers uurwerk.
Profiel
• Wat neem je mee?
• Afgeronde wo-opleiding in bedrijfseconomie. Met minimaal drie tot vijf jaar ervaring in een control rol.
• Ervaring met SAP of SAP BW, Office 365 en Excel.
• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk. Communicatief ben je sterk.
• Analytisch ben je sterk en je weet complexe financiële data te vertalen naar heldere en bruikbare inzichten voor het management.
• Proactief, ondernemend, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
• Aanbod
Deze functie geeft ruimte én verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent dé retail controller van de Nederlandse organisatie en krijgt een zelfstandige rol binnen een internationale context. Met directe betrokkenheid bij alles wat in de winkels gebeurt, ben je verzekerd van impact. Je werkt in het hart van de organisatie: het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven. Geen shared service center, maar korte lijnen en een team waar initiatief gewaardeerd wordt.
• Rechtstreeks in dienst bij The Swatch Group in Eindhoven.
• Jaarcontract (uitzicht op vast).
• 40 uur per week (32 is bespreekbaar).
• € 4.000,- tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand.
• 26 vakantiedagen per jaar.
• Mogelijkheid tot collectieve zorgverzekering.
• Ruimte voor professionele groei en ontwikkeling.
• Thuiswerken op structurele basis is niet mogelijk

jobs.description:
Boutique Manager - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager
• The company
• About Omega
Founded in 1848, OMEGA is a watch brand renowned for its excellence, innovation, and precision. Guided by a pioneering spirit, OMEGA has explored the depths of the ocean and the vastness of space, becoming the first watch worn on the moon. Its women’s timepieces are celebrated for their elegance and creativity, while advancements in anti-magnetic technology and Master Chronometer certification continue to set new standards for performance and accuracy. As the Official Timekeeper of the Olympic Games since 1932, OMEGA is also a trusted name in world sports including golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh, and sailing. Beyond its achievements in timekeeping, OMEGA supports global initiatives through partnerships with Orbis International and the GoodPlanet Foundation, and its distinguished ambassadors include George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, and many more.
Job description
About The Role
The Boutique Manager is responsible for driving the sustained growth and overall performance of the boutique, with full accountability for its daily operations, team leadership, and business results. Acting with an entrepreneurial mindset, the Boutique Manager identifies new business opportunities, maximize sales, and elevate the client experience. This role demands strong managerial, interpersonal, and technical skills to lead a high-performing team, build long-term client relationships, and consistently achieve key performance objectives in alignment with brand standards.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership
Provide clear leadership to the Boutique team by effectively communicating objectives, individual responsibilities, expected outcomes, brand standards, and operational procedures. Assign tasks accordingly, monitor progress, and ensure ongoing communication.
Coach each team member to achieve both individual and collective goals through regular team meetings, OJT, performance appraisals, proactive identification of training needs, task delegation, and consistent feedback.
• Oversee staff appearance and conduct to ensure compliant with company policies and boutique standards, including uniform, grooming, language, and overall presentation.
• Sales and Business Development
• Exceed boutique targets in accordance with brand’s retail strategy while ensuring full compliance.
• Attract and convert target prospects into boutique clients. Design and implement tailored programs to acquire high-potential customers and effectively manage the client lifecycle.
• Foster lasting relationships and cultivate loyalty with clients as a member of the Omega family by delivering exceptional service.
Identify growth opportunities and propose clienteling strategies through effective use of the CRM system. Collect, update, and manage client information, and oversee the clienteling activities performed by Sales Consultants.
Boutique Operations
• Ensure the boutique is well-maintained, including cleanliness, visually appealing displays, and adherence to Visual Merchandising (VM) guidelines.
• Comply with Group and Brand procedures as outlined in the Retail Manual. Identify operational challenges and propose effective solutions.
• Safeguard the security and proper maintenance of the timepiece stock.
• Administration & Reporting
• Manage and prepare the monthly duty roster, monitor attendance.
• Oversee and verify overtime (OT) submissions, ensuring accuracy, proper justification, and timely submission for payroll processing.
• Coordinate and participate in regular and ad-hoc stock takes, ensure accurate inventory reconciliation, and submit reports within deadlines.
• Consolidate and submit sales and operational reports, tracking key performance metrics and highlighting variances or issues to management.
• Maintain accurate records of staff attendance, leave, and operational documents such as petty cash, courier logs, and maintenance reports, ensuring administrative compliance with company policies.
• Ensure timely reporting, document submission, and effective communication of updates or policy changes to the boutique team.
• Profile
• Minimum 7 years of experience in luxury retail, with at least 2 years in a managerial role.
• Proven track record in achieving and exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment.
• Strong business acumen, analytical skills, and results-oriented mindset.
• Strong understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and ultra-high-net-worth customer behaviour.
• Collaborative approach with the ability to foster teamwork and a "can-do" attitude.
• Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning and staying updated on industry trends.
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English (additional language is a plus).
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Comfortable using Excel, Word, and SAP for operational and reporting tasks.

Boutique Manager - Swatch Group

Manager di Boutique
• L'azienda
• Su Omega
Fondata nel 1848, OMEGA è un marchio di orologi famoso per la sua eccellenza, innovazione e precisione. Guidato da uno spirito pionieristico, OMEGA ha esplorato le profondità dell'oceano e la vastità dello spazio, diventando il primo orologio indossato sulla luna. I suoi orologi da donna sono celebrati per la loro eleganza e creatività, mentre i progressi nella tecnologia antimagnetica e la certificazione Master Chronometer continuano a fissare nuovi standard per prestazioni e precisione. Come Timekeeper ufficiale dei Giochi Olimpici dal 1932, OMEGA è anche un nome di fiducia negli sport mondiali tra cui golf, nuoto, atletica, bobsleigh e vela. Oltre ai suoi successi nel timekeeping, OMEGA sostiene iniziative globali attraverso partnership con Orbis International e la Fondazione GoodPlanet, e i suoi distinti ambasciatori includono George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, e molti altri.
Descrizione del lavoro
Informazioni su The Role
Il Boutique Manager è responsabile di guidare la crescita sostenuta e le prestazioni globali della boutique, con piena responsabilità per le sue operazioni quotidiane, la leadership del team e i risultati aziendali. Agendo con una mentalità imprenditoriale, il Boutique Manager identifica nuove opportunità di business, massimizzare le vendite e aumentare l'esperienza del cliente. Questo ruolo richiede forti competenze manageriali, interpersonali e tecniche per guidare un team di alto livello, costruire relazioni cliente a lungo termine, e raggiungere costantemente obiettivi di prestazioni chiave in allineamento con gli standard del marchio.
Cosa farai
Leadership del team
Fornire una chiara leadership al team Boutique comunicando efficacemente obiettivi, responsabilità individuali, risultati attesi, standard di marca e procedure operative. Assegnare i compiti di conseguenza, monitorare i progressi e garantire la comunicazione in corso.
Allena ogni membro del team per raggiungere obiettivi sia individuali che collettivi attraverso riunioni di squadra regolari, GUT, valutazioni delle prestazioni, identificazione proattiva delle esigenze di formazione, delegazione del compito e feedback coerente.
• Superare l'aspetto e la condotta del personale per garantire la conformità con le politiche aziendali e gli standard di boutique, tra cui uniformi, cura, lingua e presentazione generale.
• Vendite e sviluppo aziendale
• Obiettivi esclusivi della boutique in conformità alla strategia di vendita al dettaglio del marchio, garantendo al contempo la piena conformità.
• Attrarre e convertire le prospettive di destinazione in clienti boutique. Progettare e implementare programmi su misura per acquisire clienti altamente potenziali e gestire efficacemente il ciclo di vita del cliente.
• Promuovere relazioni durature e coltivare la lealtà con i clienti come membro della famiglia Omega offrendo un servizio eccezionale.
Identificare le opportunità di crescita e proporre strategie di clientela attraverso un uso efficace del sistema CRM. Raccogliere, aggiornare e gestire le informazioni dei clienti e supervisionare le attività di clientela svolte da Sales Consultants.
Operazioni di Boutique
• Assicurarsi che la boutique sia ben tenuta, tra cui pulizia, display visivamente accattivanti, e l'adesione a Visual Merchandising (VM) linee guida.
• Complimenti alle procedure di Gruppo e Marchio come indicato nel Manuale al dettaglio. Identificare le sfide operative e proporre soluzioni efficaci.
• Salvaguardare la sicurezza e la corretta manutenzione dello stock di orologi.
• Amministrazione e Reporting
• Gestire e preparare il roster dei dazi mensili, monitorare la presenza.
• Controllare e verificare le richieste straordinarie (OT), garantire l'accuratezza, la corretta giustificazione e la tempestiva presentazione per l'elaborazione del libro paga.
• Coordinare e partecipare a azioni regolari e ad-hoc, garantire una accurata riconciliazione dell'inventario e presentare relazioni entro le scadenze.
• Consolidare e presentare rapporti di vendita e operativi, tracciare metriche di performance chiave e evidenziare variazioni o problemi alla gestione.
• Mantenere registri accurati della presenza del personale, del congedo e dei documenti operativi come contanti, registri dei corrieri e rapporti di manutenzione, garantendo il rispetto amministrativo delle politiche aziendali.
• Assicurare report tempestivi, presentazione dei documenti e una comunicazione efficace di aggiornamenti o modifiche politiche al team boutique.
• Profilo
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nella vendita al dettaglio di lusso, con almeno 2 anni in un ruolo manageriale.
• Provato record di traccia nel raggiungimento e superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in un ambiente competitivo.
• Forte acume aziendale, competenze analitiche e mentalità orientata ai risultati.
• Forte comprensione della mentalità dei consumatori di lusso e del comportamento dei clienti ultra-alta rete.
• approccio collaborativo con la capacità di favorire il lavoro di squadra e un atteggiamento "can-do".
• Curiosità intellettuale e passione per l'apprendimento e per rimanere aggiornati sulle tendenze del settore.

• Passione per orologi di lusso, artigianalità e patrimonio di marca.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Boutique gut gepflegt ist, einschließlich Sauberkeit, visuell ansprechende Displays und Einhaltung von Visual Merchandising (VM) Richtlinien.

• Sichern Sie die Sicherheit und die ordnungsgemäße Wartung des Zeitmessers.
• Verwaltung und Berichterstattung
• Verwalten und bereiten Sie den monatlichen Dienst-Roster, Überwachung Teilnahme.
• Überstunden (OT) zu überwachen und zu überprüfen, Genauigkeit, ordnungsgemäße Rechtfertigung und rechtzeitige Einreichung für die Lohn- und Gehaltsabwicklung zu gewährleisten.
• Koordinieren und an regelmäßigen und ad-hoc-Aktien teilnehmen, eine genaue Bestandsabstimmung gewährleisten und innerhalb von Fristen Berichte einreichen.
• Konsolidieren und übermitteln Sie Verkaufs- und Betriebsberichte, verfolgen Sie Kennzahlen und markieren Sie Varianzen oder Probleme an das Management.
• Bewahren Sie genaue Aufzeichnungen über Mitarbeiterbetreuung, Urlaub und operative Dokumente wie z.B. Kleingeld, Kurierprotokolle und Wartungsberichte, um die Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien zu gewährleisten.

Boutique Manager - Swatch Group Boutique Manager
• L'entreprise
• À propos d'Oméga Fondée en 1848, OMEGA est une marque horlogère réputée pour son excellence, son innovation et sa précision. Guidée par un esprit pionnier, OMEGA a exploré les profondeurs de l'océan et l'immensité de l'espace, devenant ainsi la première montre portée sur la lune. Ses garde-temps féminins sont célébrés pour leur élégance et leur créativité, tandis que les progrès de la technologie antimagnétique et de la certification Master Chronometer continuent de fixer de nouveaux standards de performance et de précision. En tant que chronométreur officiel des Jeux Olympiques depuis 1932, OMEGA est également un nom de confiance dans les sports mondiaux, y compris le golf, la natation, l'athlétisme, le bobsleigh et la voile. Au-delà de ses réalisations en chronologie, OMEGA soutient des initiatives mondiales par le biais de partenariats avec Orbis International et la Fondation GoodPlanet, et ses ambassadeurs distingués sont George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford et bien d'autres. Description de l'emploi À propos du rôle Le directeur de la boutique est responsable de la croissance soutenue et de la performance globale de la boutique, avec la pleine responsabilité de ses opérations quotidiennes, de son leadership d'équipe et de ses résultats opérationnels. Agissant avec un esprit d'entreprise, le directeur de Boutique identifie de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires, maximise les ventes et améliore l'expérience client. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en gestion, en relations interpersonnelles et techniques pour diriger une équipe hautement performante, établir des relations avec les clients à long terme et atteindre systématiquement des objectifs de rendement clés en conformité avec les normes de marque. Ce que vous ferez Leadership de l'équipe Fournir un leadership clair à l'équipe Boutique en communiquant efficacement les objectifs, les responsabilités individuelles, les résultats attendus, les normes de marque et les procédures opérationnelles. Assigner les tâches en conséquence, suivre les progrès et assurer la communication continue. Encadrer chaque membre de l'équipe afin d'atteindre des objectifs individuels et collectifs au moyen de réunions régulières d'équipes, d'évaluations du rendement, d'identification proactive des besoins de formation, de délégation de tâches et de rétroaction cohérente.
• Surveiller l'apparence et la conduite du personnel afin de s'assurer qu'il est conforme aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux normes de boutique, y compris l'uniforme, le toilettage, la langue et la présentation générale.
• Ventes et développement des entreprises
• Objectifs de boutique dépassés conformément à la stratégie de vente de la marque tout en assurant la pleine conformité.
• Attirer et convertir les perspectives cibles en clients de boutique. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des programmes sur mesure pour acquérir des clients à haut potentiel et gérer efficacement le cycle de vie des clients.
• Favoriser des relations durables et cultiver la loyauté avec les clients en tant que membre de la famille Omega en fournissant un service exceptionnel. Identifier les possibilités de croissance et proposer des stratégies de clientéling en utilisant efficacement le système de CRM. Recueillir, mettre à jour et gérer l'information sur les clients et superviser les activités de clientéling effectuées par les conseillers en ventes. Opérations de la boutique
• S'assurer que la boutique est bien entretenue, y compris la propreté, les affichages visuellement attrayants et le respect des lignes directrices sur la marchandisation visuelle (VM).
• Se conformer aux procédures de groupe et de marque décrites dans le manuel de vente au détail. Identifier les défis opérationnels et proposer des solutions efficaces.
• Préservez la sécurité et l'entretien du stock de montres.
• Administration et rapports
• Gérer et préparer la liste mensuelle des tâches, surveiller la présence.
• Surveiller et vérifier les demandes d'heures supplémentaires, en veillant à l'exactitude, à la justification appropriée et à la présentation en temps voulu pour le traitement des états de paie.
• Coordonner et participer à des collectes de données régulières et ponctuelles, assurer le rapprochement exact des inventaires et soumettre des rapports dans les délais.
• Consolider et soumettre des rapports sur les ventes et les opérations, suivre les principales mesures de performance et mettre en évidence les écarts ou les problèmes à la direction.
• Tenir des registres exacts des présences du personnel, des congés et des documents opérationnels tels que la petite caisse, les registres de messagerie et les rapports d'entretien, en veillant au respect administratif des politiques de l'entreprise.
• Veiller à ce que les rapports, la présentation de documents et la communication efficace des mises à jour ou des changements de politiques soient présentés en temps opportun à l'équipe de la boutique.
• Profil
• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans le commerce de détail de luxe, avec au moins 2 ans dans un rôle de gestion.
• Expérience éprouvée en matière d'atteinte et de dépassement des objectifs de vente dans un environnement concurrentiel.
• Un bon sens des affaires, des compétences analytiques et un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats.
• Une bonne compréhension de l'état d'esprit des consommateurs de luxe et du comportement des clients ultra-hauts de gamme.
• Une approche collaborative avec la capacité de favoriser le travail d'équipe et une attitude « candide ».
• La curiosité intellectuelle et la passion pour l'apprentissage et la mise à jour des tendances de l'industrie.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et présentation en anglais (la langue supplémentaire est un plus).
• Passion pour les montres de luxe, l'artisanat et le patrimoine de la marque.
• Confortable en utilisant Excel, Word et SAP pour les tâches opérationnelles et de rapport.

jobs.description:
Sales Consultant - Swatch Group

Sales Consultant
• The company
• About Longines
• Longines, the prestigious Swiss watchmaker renowned for its timeless elegance, heritage, and performance, is seeking a passionate Sales Consultant to join its distinguished team.
In this role, you’ll be the welcoming face of Longines, helping customers find the perfect timepiece while delivering warm, attentive service. From greeting clients to assisting them with their final selection, you’ll create meaningful moments that reflect Longines’ rich history and enduring values.
Job description
• What You'll Be Doing
• Client Engagement & Sales
• Greet every client warmly, acknowledging their presence promptly upon entering the boutique.
• Understand client preferences through attentive listening and thoughtful conversation.
• Share the unique stories behind our timepieces, highlighting features, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Meet and exceed individual sales goals while contributing to overall boutique performance.
• Take pride in presenting the right product for each client, offering recommendations that are both relevant and inspiring.
• Client Relationship Management (CRM)
• Cultivate long-term relationships with clients by maintaining regular, thoughtful follow-ups and exclusive invitations to events or launches.
• Manage and grow an active client book through CRM tools and clienteling best practices.
• Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when serving high-profile and international clientele.
• Brand & Product Knowledge
• Maintain deep product knowledge across collections and novelties, including movements, materials, and craftsmanship.
• Stay updated on brand history, key milestones, and current campaigns to support brand storytelling.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
• Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
• Uphold company procedures and policies related to operation, customer service, security and compliance.
• Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces.
• Monitor competitors’ marketing activities and provide regular market intelligence to the Management.
• Work closely with your team to create a supportive, positive environment
• Profile
• Minimum 2 years of sales experience in luxury, premium retail, or lifestyle brands.
• Passionate about client service and delivering exceptional experiences.
• Professional, well-groomed, and confident in engaging with diverse clientele.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.

jobs.description:
Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Cortina - Swatch Group

Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Cortina
The company
Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo steso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti.
Job description
Per uno dei nostri Corporate Store Swatch sito nell'area di Cortina, ricerchiamo uno/a ASSISTANT STORE MANAGER con pregressa esperienza in mansione analoga. L’Assistant Store Manager, garantirà il supporto allo Store Manager nel guidare e coordinare lo staff e le attività del negozio. Inoltre contribuirà alla massimizzazione del potenziale commerciale in linea con la strategia aziendale. Sarà il portavoce dei valori e della cultura SWATCH.
Profile
In particolare, le principali responsabilità saranno:
• Seguire il cliente in tutta la sua esperienza di vendita con l'obiettivo di fornire un eccellente servizio al cliente, indagando sulle opportunità, sviluppando soluzioni e fornendo un esempio attivo e costante allo staff nella risoluzione di simili sfide future.
• Garantire il servizio di assistenza tecnica post-vendita sul prodotto e la corretta applicazione della garanzia.
• Raggiungere e/o superare gli obiettivi di vendita.
• KPI quantitativi e qualitativi del negozio.
• Collaborare proattivamente con lo Store Manager per garantire che il negozio disponga di risorse adeguate al raggiungimento e al superamento degli obiettivi di performance.
• Supervisionare e garantire una formazione costante al team secondo le linee guida stabilite dallo Store Manager.
• Redigere l'agenda delle attività quotidiane, inclusa la pianificazione oraria dello staff.
• Gestire la sicurezza legata alle attività di cassa: procedure di pagamento, tax-free, processi di apertura e chiusura della cassa utilizzando i programmi dedicati, procedura depositi bancari.
• Garantire il mantenimento degli eccellenti standard di visual merchandising, rispettando le linee guida assegnate.
• Analizzare proattivamente le esigenze di inventario e di stock per garantire il corretto assortimento dei prodotti.
• Collaborare trasversalmente con i principali dipartimenti per garantire l’efficienza dell’utilizzo degli spazi del negozio e del loro mantenimento a livelli di eccellenza.
• Garantire l'analisi e il controllo dei prodotti in magazzino, e reportistica.
• Garantire il rispetto dei processi amministrativi e contabili.
• In accordo con lo Store Manager, garantire l'eccellenza delle attività in store con un costante focus sul cliente.
• Favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e coinvolgente e di ispirazione.
• Sguardo curioso e aperto alla scoperta costante di nuovi possibili talenti esterni da far entrare nel team.
Professional requirements
Ci piacerebbe incontrare candidati con i seguenti requisiti:
• Esperienza pregressa in ruolo analogo in aziende retail strutturate che operano attraverso un livello elevato di servizio e di consulenza al cliente.
• Ottime capacità di comunicazione.
• Capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione.
• Orientamento ai risultati e ottima capacità di analisi.
• Conoscenza approfondita della customer experience applicata al settore retail.
• Solida esperienza nel lavoro e nel raggiungimento di KPI e obiettivi di vendita.
• Capacità di stabilire le priorità, di lavorare con dinamismo e flessibilità e di comunicare in modo efficace
• Gestione della complessità e di operare in un ambiente multi-tasking.
• Ottimo utilizzo del feedback volto alla crescita e al miglioramento delle competenze delle risorse del team.
• Proattività, problem solving, capacità di lavorare in gruppo con spirito proattivo e positivo, grande attenzione ai dettagli.
• Iniziativa, dinamismo ed entusiasmo.
• Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese sia parlato che scritto.
• Conoscenza avanzata di MS Office, in particolare di Excel.

jobs.title: Swatch Assistant Store Manager - Cherry Creek (Denver)
jobs.location: 0200 English Search Search Swatch Assistant Store Manager
jobs.description:
Swatch Assistant Store Manager - Cherry Creek (Denver) - Swatch Group

Swatch Assistant Store Manager - Cherry Creek (Denver)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
We are seeking an experienced, retail Store Manager to provide leadership in our Swatch Store. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales, and delivering customer service skills.
Profile
Profile:
Drives sales and supports sales objectives
Performs daily activities of operating a specialty retail store
Work together with the Store Manager to direct a cohesive and high-functioning team
Sets the standard of a superior level of customer service and sales volume
Maintains visual merchandising standards
Develops and motivates staff; leads by example
Protects the security of cash, inventory, and other company assets according to guidelines and directives
Brings positive recognition to the SWATCH brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude and professionalism
Professional requirements
Professional
• Requirements:
All candidates should have at least 3-5 years of experience in an Assistant Manager position, specialty retail preferred
Team-oriented
Creative approach to problem solving
Ability to think and react in a high-energy, fast-paced environment
Sense of responsibility and accountability
Proactive attitude
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1stof the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
Internal transfer and growth potential
$500 Employee Referral Bonuses
For more information, please see: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/
Hourly Rate: $25.00 - $28.00/Hr. plus commission

80206 Denver (Colorado)
United States

jobs.description:
Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Store Manager with Longines, you are responsible for driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientelling skills. You will manage, mentor, and develop a highly specialized sales team to the Company brand standard. You will own your brand at the store level. You will help to ensure all promotions, product training, and floor presentations are effectively in place to execute what will happen to drive sales today as well as for future growth. You will the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
• Responsibilities:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service,
• events, collaborating and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Experience in selling timepieces is a big plus.
• Ensure of proper staffing of the store thru recruitment and retention.
• Train and lead employees to successful selling and customer service.
• Responsible for achievement of annual sales goals
• Oversee assigning of monthly sales goals to associates
• Conduct regular management meetings to review performance, operations, and employee relations issues, and to discuss strategy with management team
• Review status of sales associates' clientele development, including review of client books
• Conduct orientation, train, coach, and manage all employees in execution of daily tasks and to maximize sales including completion of all reviews and performance assessment procedures.
• Collaborate with HR to oversee recruitment and hiring of store staff.
• Coordinate and actively participate in in-store activities, which include seasonal events, trunk shows, contests, and all involved tasks.
• Adhere to and oversee compliance of established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of
• Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, sales and record-keeping procedures, and overall maintenance of the store.
• Ensure that proper channels of communication exist between the store and Corporate Office.
• Help solve problems that affect the store's service, efficiency, and productivity.
• All other duties assigned by Management
• Requirements
• Must have a High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
• Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Business or equivalent preferred
• Must have 3-5+ years’ retail store experience; leadership experience with sales and luxury merchandise a plus
• Strong multi-dimensional leadership ability, enjoy working in a culturally diverse environment
• Able to make sound decisions with relevant facts at hand and drive for results
• Good problem solving skills
• Must be able understand and analyze financial details of retail business
• Ability to provide outstanding customer service in line with Brand expectations
• Excellent selling and customer service skills
• Work independently and on weekends and outside of regular office hours
• Fluency in English and other languages as required by location
• Must have excellent oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal skills.
• Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint)
• Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality
• Must be able to adhere to deadlines and response to inquiries within a require time frame
• Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
• The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
• Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
• Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
• Ability to deal with conflict and able to influence across functional lines
• Bilingual is a plus.
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Store Manager to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 5 - 7 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a work day. Requires to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to work an average of 40 hours per week. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 days of PTO per year
• Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount

descriptionByLocale.it:
Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX)
La Società
Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie.
Descrizione del lavoro
Come Store Manager con Longines, sei responsabile della guida delle vendite, della fornitura di un servizio clienti raffinato e della dimostrazione di forti competenze di clientela. Potrai gestire, mentore e sviluppare un team di vendita altamente specializzato allo standard del marchio aziendale. Possiederai il tuo marchio a livello negozio. Si contribuirà a garantire tutte le promozioni, formazione del prodotto e presentazioni del pavimento sono effettivamente in atto per eseguire ciò che accadrà per guidare le vendite oggi e per la crescita futura. Sarete il marchio, dentro e fuori la boutique.
Profilo
• Responsabilità:
• Capacità di costruire ricavi, gestire operazioni di back-office e supervisionare i professionisti della vendita.
• Sviluppare le strategie e i piani per raggiungere i risultati delle vendite attraverso la clientela, il servizio clienti superiore,
• eventi, collaborazioni e azioni generatrici di traffico.
• Assicurare un'esperienza di negozio coerente e di qualità per i clienti.
• Pensare strategicamente e guidare il business agli standard aziendali.
• Priorizzare, pianificare, delegare, amministrare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali.
• Massimizzare le tecniche di inventario, controllo dei contanti e prevenzione delle perdite.
• L'esperienza nella vendita di orologi è un grande vantaggio.
• Assicurare un corretto personale del negozio di reclutamento e di ritenzione.
• Formare e portare i dipendenti alla vendita di successo e al servizio clienti.
• Responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita annuali
• Superare l'assegnazione degli obiettivi di vendita mensili agli associati
• Condurre riunioni di gestione regolari per rivedere le prestazioni, le operazioni e le relazioni con i dipendenti, e discutere la strategia con il team di gestione
• Stato di revisione dello sviluppo della clientela dei partner commerciali, inclusa la revisione dei libri dei clienti
• Condurre l'orientamento, il treno, l'allenatore e gestire tutti i dipendenti nell'esecuzione dei compiti quotidiani e massimizzare le vendite, compreso il completamento di tutte le recensioni e le procedure di valutazione delle prestazioni.
• Collaborare con le risorse umane per supervisionare il reclutamento e l'assunzione del personale del negozio.
• Coordinare e partecipare attivamente alle attività di deposito, che includono eventi stagionali, spettacoli di tronchi, concorsi e tutte le attività coinvolte.
• Adeguarsi e supervisionare la conformità delle politiche e degli standard aziendali consolidati, come il mantenimento della sicurezza
• Fondi aziendali e proprietà, pratiche del personale, procedure di sicurezza, vendite e registrazione, e la manutenzione complessiva del negozio.
• Assicurarsi che esistano canali di comunicazione appropriati tra il negozio e l'Ufficio aziendale.
• Aiuta a risolvere i problemi che influiscono sul servizio, sull'efficienza e sulla produttività del negozio.
• Tutte le altre funzioni assegnate dalla Direzione
• Requisiti
• Deve avere un diploma di scuola superiore, GED o equivalente
• Laurea in Management, Business o equivalente preferito
• Deve avere esperienza di negozio al dettaglio di 3-5 anni; esperienza di leadership con vendite e merce di lusso un plus
• Forte capacità di leadership multidimensionale, godere di lavorare in un ambiente culturalmente vario
• In grado di prendere decisioni sonore con fatti pertinenti a portata di mano e guidare per i risultati
• Buone capacità di problem solving
• Deve essere in grado di comprendere e analizzare i dettagli finanziari del commercio al dettaglio
• Capacità di fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale in linea con le aspettative del marchio
• Eccellente capacità di vendita e servizio clienti
• Lavorare in modo indipendente e nei fine settimana e al di fuori delle ore di ufficio regolari

• Veranstaltungen, gemeinsame und verkehrserzeugende Aktionen.

• Priorisieren, planen, delegieren, administrieren und sich an die Geschäftsbedürfnisse anpassen.
• Maximieren Sie Inventar-, Cash-Control- und Verlustvorbeugungstechniken.
• Erfahrung im Verkauf von Zeitmessern ist ein großes Plus.
• Gewährleistung einer ordnungsgemäßen Personalisierung des Ladens durch Rekrutierung und Retention.
• Trainieren und führen Mitarbeiter zu einem erfolgreichen Verkauf und Kundendienst.
• Verantwortlich für die Erreichung der jährlichen Umsatzziele
• Übersehen Sie die Zuweisung von monatlichen Verkaufszielen an Mitarbeiter
• Durchführung regelmäßiger Managementsitzungen zur Überprüfung von Leistungs-, Arbeits- und Arbeitsbeziehungen und zur Diskussion der Strategie mit dem Managementteam

jobs.description:
Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As an Assistant Store Manager with Longines, the position will responsible for assisting in directing the efforts of, and is responsible for, the results of the store and sales associates. This includes but is not limited to: accomplishing and exceeding store wide sales targets, providing support to Store Manager, assist in training; coaching of retail staff, retaining and building client relationships, as well as actively seek new client relationships. This person must be energetic and enthusiastic, be willing to engage customers with a sales-minded attitude, and display pride in our stores through strong work ethics, organizational skills and cleanliness. You will the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
Duties and
• Responsibilities
Performs daily activities of operating boutique as per company standards inclusive of maximizing inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Assist with the implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clienteling, superior customer service, events, partnering, and traffic generating actions.
Deliver sells results as per company goals.
Delegate and assign tasks to the sales team.
Assist in the development sales incentives and rewards within the store.
Ensures a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
Brings positive recognition to the brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude, professionalism and in-depth brand knowledge.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Train and lead employees to successful selling and customer service.
Partner with the Store Manager to ensure that proper channels of communication exist between the store and Corporate Office.
Help solve problems that affect the store's service, efficiency, and productivity.
Partnering with Store Manager on the responsibilities of the achievement of annual sales goals
Collaborate with the Store Manager on the coordination of the in-store activities, which include seasonal events, trunk shows, contests, and all involved tasks.
Adhere to and oversee compliance of established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, sales and record-keeping procedures, and overall maintenance of the store.
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience
• Requirements
Must have a High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Business or equivalent preferred
Must have 3-5+ years’ retail store experience; leadership experience with sales and merchandise a plus
Good problem solving skills
Ability to provide outstanding customer service in line with Brand expectations
Excellent selling and customer service skills
Work independently and on weekends and outside of regular office hours
Fluency in English and other languages as required by location
Must have excellent oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal skills.
Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint)
Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality
Must be able to adhere to deadlines and response to inquiries within a require time frame
Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
Ability to deal with conflict and able to influence across functional lines
Physical
• Requirements
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Assistant Store Manager to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 3 – 5 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a 1 – 12 hour day. May be required to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to work an average of 48 hours per week. operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Potrai anche assistere la gestione nella guida del team di associati per garantire compiti e procedure operative sono di successo, così come le routine di apertura e chiusura sono completati, il tutto mantenendo il cliente in prima linea. jobs.description:
Sales Assistant - part time 20 ore - Modena - contratto temporaneo - Swatch Group

Sales Assistant - part time 20 ore - Modena - contratto temporaneo
The company
Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo stesso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti.
Job description
DINAMICITA’, SFIDA, INNOVAZIONE, PASSIONE, sono parole nelle quali ti riconosci? Allora siamo noi il tuo futuro lavorativo! The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. ricerca nuovi talenti da inserire nei nostri negozi Corporate a marchio SWATCH di Modena come venditori part time 20 ore, con contratto temporaneo. In qualità di sales assistant garantirai un’esperienza di vendita eccellente ai nostri clienti, dal punto di vista della cura e realizzazione dei desideri. Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. Parteciperai all’organizzazione del negozio assicurandoti che il punto vendita, il back office e lo stock siano sempre in ordine. Inoltre garantirai la corretta presentazione dell'immagine dei brand SWATCH e FLIK FLAK.
Profile
- Hai esperienza nel Retail (vendita/gestione resi/ordini etc..)
- Hai orientamento commerciale
- Sei dinamico e flessibile
- Sei disponibile a lavorare su turni avvicendati
- Hai buone doti relazionali e buone capacità comunicative
- Hai una buona capacità di identificare gli interlocutori ed adattare la comunicazione e l’interazione con essi a seconda delle situazioni (ad es. gestione obiezioni e conflitti)
- Sei un problem solver di natura
Professional requirements
Hai dimestichezza con il PC ed il pacchettoOffice e gli applicativi di comunicazione. Conosci i principali strumenti informatici ed hai un’elevata predisposizione all’uso della tecnologia. Per qualcuno l’orologio misura “solo” il tempo, per noi scandisce in ogni minuto la nostra vera passione! Unisciti a NOI! Vini a far parte del nostro Team!
Languages
Hai un’ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, la conoscenza di altre lingue sarà considerata un plus.
Contact
Alessia Nicosia
Job location
Via Emilia 141/143
41121 Modena (Emilia Romagna)

Via Washington, 70

jobs.title: Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall)
jobs.description:
Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall) - Swatch Group

Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Associate, you will report to the Store Manager and be responsible for achieving sales targets. You will act as a Swatch Brand Ambassador while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
Starting base pay of $18.05 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Deliver exceptional customer service by assisting customers and resolving issues with a positive attitude. Achieve and exceed sales targets though outstanding product knowledge.
• Operations: Support daily operations, including processing sales and returns, inventory management, and adhering to operation policies and procedures.
• Visual Merchandising: Assist in maintaining store’s visual standards by following visual merchandising guidelines. Assists in maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the store.
• Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards.
• Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS
Employment Status:
Part-Time: 10 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 10 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
