jobs.title: PR & Events Manager
jobs.description:
PR & Events Manager - Swatch Group

PR & Events Manager
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Public Relations & Events Manager with Rado, U.S. & Caribbean, the position will be responsible for developing and implementing the brand’s PR and media strategy, building its reputation, image and ensuring effective media coverage along with events execution. As a PR & Events Manager, you will draft or oversee the creation of media releases and content on various media channels, forge relationships with journalists and key influencers and manage the response to time- sensitive and critical situations. The PR & Events Manager will be responsible for day-to-day media relations activities for the Brand.
Profile
Primary Duties and
• Responsibilities
Grow brand awareness and market share through strategic product PR campaigns
Works collaboratively with Marketing Manager to align PR strategy with business/marketing communications objectives and to support overall marketing plans.
Manage yearly planning and implementation of product PR campaigns under guidance from the global marketing communications team and in close collaboration with local marketing management (MM).
Develop public relations strategies for current and existing products, launches, and promotions
Generate new ideas and opportunities to ensure brands’ success
Develop and produce high-quality, informative, and interesting press releases, press kits, and related materials if not provided by HQ
Act as project lead for PR initiatives from concept development through execution.
Create presentations, reports, and information for multiple communication channels
Responsible for U.S. media relations, manage contacts, and facilitate networking for SG Corporate and brand executive.
Ensure proactive contact with the different media through regular interaction.
Manage and send watches as needed for photoshoots, PR placements, etc.
Analyzes the quantitative and qualitative outputs of PR programs and placements to maximize effectiveness and ROI.
Create and manage PR budget including the deadlines, objectives and schedule and invoicing process
Events
Plan and execute all local and national events for the Rado Brand in the US with retail partners, national branding events, PR events and sponsorships
Manage overall event responsibilities including location scouting and selection, all planning, run-of-show creation and management, creative theme development, travel management, security coordination, on-site permits and logistics
Implement planning timelines to coordinate pre-event proposals, approvals and logistics, set-up, on-site team schedule, and overall run of events
Pre-event preparation and approvals and post-event recaps and analysis preparation
Develop weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual media activity reports
Consistently brainstorm and collaborate with team for new ideas and strategies
Develop and maintain good relationships with media and industry leaders
Oversee the event budget, including budget planning, monitoring, and SAP administrative processes
Create presentations, articles, reports, and information for web sites, blogs, and social media accounts
Domestic and International travel required
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education & Experience Requirement
Must have 7 or more years of related PR experience (consumer luxury products, media, agency, corporate environment)
Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Advertising, Journalism, Marketing or Business
Must have knowledge and experience of traditional and new / social / digital media PR tactics.
Excellent communication and writing skills are essential
Event Planning experience
Strong media contacts and relations with a record of success in securing national and top-tier media placements
Ability to foster relationships and maintain connections
Must thrive in a fast-paced, fluid environment and be able to prioritize multiple responsibilities, projects
Able to work weekends as needed; Travel up to 35%
Physical
• Requirements:
This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Public Relations & Events Manager to have the ability to move about the office occasionally, operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Additional Skill
• Requirements:
Able to organize and execute events
Savvy in social media
Able to identify and work closely with bloggers and influencers.
Must be a confident communicator and presenter
Ability to work in high-stress environments, often for long hours
Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;
Must possess strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills with multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced corporate environment;
Arrive early and work late if necessary
Understand and follow posted work rules and procedures
Accept constructive feedback
Must be a team player
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Public Relations & Events Manager. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year, 1 Month PTO after 5 years
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Händlernetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind. Jobbeschreibung Als Public Relations & Events Manager bei Rado, U.S. & Caribbean, wird die Position für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der PR- und Medienstrategie der Marke verantwortlich sein, deren Ruf, Image und die Sicherstellung einer effektiven Medienberichterstattung zusammen mit der Durchführung von Veranstaltungen. Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de vente au détail multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important des technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe indispensables à l'horlogerie et à d'autres industries. Description de l'emploi En tant que responsable des relations publiques et des événements avec Rado, États-Unis et Caraïbes, le poste sera chargé d'élaborer et de mettre en œuvre la stratégie des relations publiques et des médias de la marque, de renforcer sa réputation, son image et d'assurer une couverture médiatique efficace ainsi que l'exécution des événements. En tant que gestionnaire des relations publiques et des événements, vous rédigerez ou superviserez la création de communiqués de presse et de contenus sur divers canaux médiatiques, établirez des relations avec les journalistes et les principaux influenceurs et gérerez la réponse aux situations critiques et sensibles au temps. Le gestionnaire PR & Events sera responsable des activités quotidiennes de relations avec les médias pour la marque. Profil Fonctions principales et responsabilités Accroître la sensibilisation à la marque et la part de marché grâce à des campagnes stratégiques de relations publiques Travaille en collaboration avec le directeur du marketing afin d'harmoniser la stratégie de relations publiques avec les objectifs de communication commerciale et commerciale et de soutenir les plans de marketing globaux. Gérer la planification et la mise en œuvre annuelles des campagnes de relations publiques sous la direction de l'équipe de communication marketing mondial et en étroite collaboration avec la gestion marketing locale (MM). Élaborer des stratégies de relations publiques pour les produits, les lancements et les promotions actuels et existants Générer de nouvelles idées et des occasions d'assurer la réussite des marques Élaborer et produire des communiqués de presse, des dossiers de presse et des documents connexes de haute qualité, informatifs et intéressants, s'il n'est pas fourni par la Loi sur l'AC comme chef de projet pour les initiatives de relations publiques, de l'élaboration de concepts à l'exécution. Créer des présentations, des rapports et de l'information pour de multiples canaux de communication Responsable des relations avec les médias américains, gérer les contacts et faciliter le réseautage pour SG Corporate et les dirigeants de marque. Assurer un contact proactif avec les différents médias grâce à une interaction régulière. Gérer et envoyer les montres au besoin pour les séances photo, les placements PR, etc. Analyser les extrants quantitatifs et qualitatifs des programmes de relations publiques et des placements pour maximiser l'efficacité et le rendement. Créer et gérer le budget des relations publiques, y compris les échéances, les objectifs, le calendrier et le processus de facturation Événements Planifier et exécuter tous les événements locaux et nationaux pour la marque Rado aux États-Unis avec des partenaires de détail, des événements de marque nationaux, des événements de relations publiques et des commandites Gérer les responsabilités générales des événements, y compris le repérage et la sélection des lieux, toutes les activités de planification, la création et la gestion de spectacles, le développement de thèmes créatifs, la gestion des voyages, la coordination de la sécurité, les permis sur place et la logistique Mettre en place des calendriers de planification pour coordonner les propositions, les approbations et la logistique avant les événements, la mise en place, le calendrier des équipes sur place et le déroulement global des événements Préparation et approbations préalables aux événements et récapitulations et préparation de l'analyse Élaboration de rapports d'activités hebdomadaires, mensuels, trimestriels et annuels sur les médias et collaboration avec l'équipe pour de nouvelles idées et stratégies Élaborer et maintenir de bonnes relations avec les médias et les dirigeants de l'industrie Superviser le budget des événements, y compris la planification budgétaire, le suivi et les processus administratifs SAP Créer des présentations, des articles, des rapports Doit avoir un baccalauréat en communications, en publicité, en journalisme, en marketing ou en affaires Doit avoir des connaissances et une expérience des tactiques de relations publiques traditionnelles et nouvelles / sociales / numériques. Excellentes compétences en communication et en écriture sont essentielles Expérience de planification d'événements Des contacts et des relations solides avec les médias avec un record de succès dans l'obtention de placements médiatiques nationaux et de haut niveau Capacité de favoriser les relations et de maintenir des liens doit prospérer dans un environnement fluide et rapide et être en mesure de prioriser les responsabilités multiples, les projets capables de travailler les week-ends au besoin; Voyage jusqu'à 35 % Matériel
• Exigences : Il s'agit principalement d'un poste de bureau sédentaire qui exige que le gestionnaire des relations publiques et des événements ait la capacité de se déplacer à l'occasion, d'exploiter l'équipement informatique, de parler, d'entendre, de plier, de s'abaisser, d'atteindre, de soulever et de transporter jusqu'à 25 livres. La dextérité du doigt est nécessaire. Compétences supplémentaires
• Exigences : Capacité d'organiser et d'exécuter des événements Savvy dans les médias sociaux Capacité d'identifier et de travailler en étroite collaboration avec les blogueurs et les influenceurs. Doit être un communicateur et un présentateur confiants Capacité de travailler dans des environnements de stress élevé, souvent pendant de longues heures Doit être automotivé et auto-démarrant; apprendre rapidement pour une entreprise multiforme et un personnel national et international compagnon; Doit posséder des compétences solides en gestion d'organisation, de projet et de résolution de problèmes avec des capacités de multitâche dans un environnement d'entreprise rapide; Arrivée précoce et travail tardif si nécessaire Comprendre et suivre les règles et procédures de travail affichées Accepter la rétroaction constructive Doit être un joueur d'équipe Cette description décrit les responsabilités et les exigences de base du rôle. jobs.description:
Credit Representative - Swatch Group

Credit Representative
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Credit Representative with the Swatch Group, you will support both accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including collections, customer account management, invoice processing, vendor payments, reconciliations, and credit-related administrative activities. You will collaborate with internal teams, brands, and retailers to ensure financial accuracy, timely processing, and strong customer service.
Profile
Primary Duties and
• Responsibilities
Review customer orders on hold daily and release within authorized limits or obtain required approvals.
Perform daily collection activities for assigned customer accounts, including past due and upcoming balances.
Obtain payment remittance details for unapplied payments within 48 hours whenever possible.
Complete monthly customer accounts receivable reconciliations and document action plans for resolution.
Maintain accounts receivable and deduction levels within established company guidelines.
Partner with brands and retailers to address credit-related needs and support account resolution.
Minimize bad debt exposure through proactive account management and collection efforts.
Research and resolve customer chargebacks and deductions within established timelines.
Process customer credit card payments and provide receipts to the appropriate internal contact.
Prepare and distribute customer statements and other requested account information in a timely manner.
Maintain accurate and current customer master data and submit updates as needed.
Document collection efforts and retain customer records in accordance with internal control requirements.
Prepare customer account offsets and required adjustments prior to month-end close
Additional
• Responsibilities
Provide support for special projects, reporting, and other assignments as directed by the Credit Manager or senior management.
Maintain confidentiality of financial, customer, and company information.
Collaborate with team members to ensure deadlines, service expectations, and compliance standards are met.
Support process improvement efforts within AR and credit operations.
Work additional hours as needed to meet business demands and critical deadlines.
Requirements
Education and Experience
• Requirements
Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of two years of experience in finance, credit, accounts receivable, collections, chargebacks, or reconciliations required.
Experience working in a high-volume transactional environment preferred.
Physical
• Requirements:
Must be able to operate a computer and other standard office equipment.
Must be able to communicate effectively, including speaking and hearing.
Ability to bend, stoop, reach, and perform repetitive hand and finger movements.
Must be able to lift, move, and carry up to 25 pounds on an occasional basis.
Additional Skill
• Requirements:
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Experience using SAP or similar ERP/accounting systems preferred.
Working knowledge of accounts receivable, collections, reconciliations, and basic credit processes, including order review, release and order management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Professional demeanor with strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
Self-motivated, dependable, and adaptable to changing priorities.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Credit Representative. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Rappresentante di Credito - Swatch Group Rappresentante di Credito L'azienda Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti. Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie. Descrizione del lavoro In qualità di Rappresentante di Credito presso il Gruppo Swatch, supporterai sia le funzioni di credito che quelle di pagamento dei conti, comprese le collezioni, la gestione del conto cliente, l'elaborazione delle fatture, i pagamenti dei venditori, le conciliazioni e le attività amministrative relative al credito. Collaborerai con team interni, marchi e rivenditori per garantire accuratezza finanziaria, elaborazione tempestiva e forte servizio clienti. Profilato Proprietà primarie e
• Responsabilità Controllare gli ordini del cliente in attesa di ogni giorno e rilasciare entro limiti autorizzati o ottenere le approvazioni richieste. Eseguire le attività di raccolta giornaliera per gli account clienti assegnati, compresi i bilance precedenti e i prossimi saldi. Ottenere i dettagli di rimesse di pagamento per i pagamenti non applicati entro 48 ore quando possibile. Conti mensili completi di clienti creditibili riconciliazione e documenti piani di azione per la risoluzione. Mantenere i livelli di credito e deduzione dei conti all'interno delle linee guida aziendali stabilite. Partner con marchi e rivenditori per affrontare le esigenze legate al credito e sostenere la risoluzione del conto. Minimizzare l'esposizione al debito cattivo attraverso la gestione del conto proattivo e gli sforzi di raccolta. Ricerca e risoluzione dei costi e deduzioni dei clienti entro tempi stabiliti. Elaborare pagamenti con carta di credito del cliente e fornire ricevute al contatto interno appropriato. Preparare e distribuire le dichiarazioni dei clienti e altre informazioni del conto richieste in modo tempestivo. Mantenere i dati accurati e correnti del cliente master e inviare gli aggiornamenti come necessario. Gli sforzi di raccolta di documenti e conservare i record dei clienti in conformità con i requisiti di controllo interno. Preparare gli offset dell'account cliente e le regolazioni richieste prima di fine mese chiudere Aggiuntivo
• Responsabilità Fornire supporto per progetti speciali, reporting e altre assegnazioni come indicato dal Credit Manager o senior management. Mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni finanziarie, clienti e aziendali. Collabora con i membri del team per garantire scadenze, aspettative di servizio e standard di conformità sono soddisfatti. Sostenere gli sforzi di miglioramento del processo all'interno di AR e operazioni di credito. Lavorare ore aggiuntive in base alle esigenze aziendali e alle scadenze critiche. Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.

Représentant du crédit - Swatch Group

Représentant du crédit
La société
Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.
Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de distribution multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important dans les technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe essentielles pour l'horlogerie et d'autres industries.
Description de l'emploi
En tant que représentant du crédit auprès du Groupe Swatch, vous assumerez les fonctions de débiteurs et de créditeurs, y compris les recouvrements, la gestion des comptes clients, le traitement des factures, les paiements des fournisseurs, les rapprochements et les activités administratives liées au crédit. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes internes, des marques et des détaillants pour assurer l'exactitude financière, le traitement en temps opportun et un service à la clientèle solide.
Profil
Fonctions principales et
• Responsabilités
Examiner les commandes des clients en attente quotidienne et la libération dans les limites autorisées ou obtenir les approbations requises.
Effectuer des activités quotidiennes de collecte pour les comptes clients assignés, y compris les soldes dus et à venir.
Obtenir les détails de paiement pour les paiements non appliqués dans les 48 heures si possible.
Compléter les rapprochements mensuels des comptes clients et documenter les plans d'action pour la résolution.
Maintenir les montants à recevoir et les retenues conformément aux lignes directrices établies.
S'associer avec les marques et les détaillants pour répondre aux besoins liés au crédit et à la résolution des comptes de soutien.
Réduire au minimum l'exposition aux créances douteuses grâce à la gestion proactive des comptes et aux efforts de recouvrement.
Effectuer des recherches et régler les rappels et les retenues des clients dans les délais établis.
Traiter les paiements par carte de crédit du client et fournir les reçus au contact interne approprié.
Préparer et distribuer en temps opportun les relevés des clients et les autres renseignements sur les comptes demandés.
Maintenez des données de base précises et actuelles et soumettez les mises à jour au besoin.
Collecte de documents et conservation des dossiers clients conformément aux exigences de contrôle interne.
Préparer les compensations de compte client et les ajustements nécessaires avant la clôture du mois
Complémentaire
• Responsabilités
Fournir un soutien pour des projets spéciaux, des rapports et d'autres affectations conformément aux directives du gestionnaire du crédit ou de la haute direction.
Maintenir la confidentialité des renseignements financiers, sur les clients et sur l'entreprise.
Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe pour s'assurer que les délais, les attentes en matière de services et les normes de conformité sont respectés.
Appuyer les efforts d'amélioration des processus au sein des opérations d'EI et de crédit.
Travailler des heures supplémentaires au besoin pour répondre aux demandes des entreprises et aux échéances critiques.
Exigences
Éducation et expérience
• Exigences
Diplôme associé en comptabilité, finances ou un domaine connexe préféré.
Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans les domaines des finances, du crédit, des débiteurs, des recouvrements, des remises ou des rapprochements requis.
Expérience de travail dans un environnement transactionnel à volume élevé préféré.
Physique
• Exigences:
Doit pouvoir utiliser un ordinateur et d'autres équipements de bureau standard.
Doit pouvoir communiquer efficacement, y compris parler et entendre.
Capacité de plier, d'atterrir, d'atteindre et d'effectuer des mouvements répétitifs des mains et des doigts.
Doit être capable de soulever, déplacer, et porter jusqu'à 25 livres sur une base occasionnelle.
Compétences supplémentaires
• Exigences:
Compétence dans Microsoft Office, y compris Word, Excel et Outlook.
Expérience d'utilisation de SAP ou de systèmes ERP/comptabilité similaires préférés.
Connaissance opérationnelle des comptes débiteurs, des recouvrements, des rapprochements et des processus de crédit de base, y compris l'examen des commandes, la libération et la gestion des commandes.
Forte capacité de communication écrite et verbale en anglais.
Fortes compétences organisationnelles, gestion du temps et résolution de problèmes.
Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement rapide.
Une grande attention aux détails et à l'engagement envers l'exactitude.
Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe.
Déontologie professionnelle avec de solides compétences interpersonnelles et de service à la clientèle.
Capacité de traiter les renseignements confidentiels avec discrétion.
Automotivé, fiable et adaptable à l'évolution des priorités.

Omega Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Scottsdale - Swatch Group

Omega Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Scottsdale
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.

The Ideal candidate must be experienced in luxury retail sales and operations management with a strong focus on driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills. OMEGA est le chronométreur officiel de 30 Jeux Olympiques depuis 1932 et est également un leader dans le golf, la natation, l'athlétisme, le bobsleigh et la voile. Les partenariats avec les causes sociales comprennent Orbis International et son hôpital Flying Eye, ainsi que la Fondation GoodPlanet. Aujourd'hui, la famille des ambassadeurs de marque d'OMEGA comprend James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin et bien d'autres encore. Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Aventura Mall - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Aventura Mall
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job Description:
At Swatch we provide our Retail Key holders with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.
Profile
Job
• Profile:
Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
Reach & exceed your sales goals
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
Handle multi-tasking with ease
Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
Professional requirements
Professional
• Requirements:
3-5 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
Able to plan, set and achieve goals
Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills

The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer the following benefits to our part-time positions:
Excellent health insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Employee product discount

Internal transfer and growth potential

Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.

Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Jobbeschreibung
Swatch umfasst die Werte, die in der Welt der Kunst, des Designs, der Mode und der Technologie koexistieren, und verleiht ihnen einen eigenen Funken von Kreativität. So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Cutting Edge-Stil, Trend-Setting-Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen einer Swatch hinzugefügt.
Job Beschreibung:
Bei Swatch bieten wir unseren Retail Key-Haltern die Ausbildung und Unterstützung, die den Grundstein für eine berufliche Karriere mit echtem Momentum legt. Als Mitglied des Retail Sales Teams werden Sie auf Verkaufstechniken und Kundendienstfähigkeiten sowie technische Schulungen zu all unseren Uhren und Dienstleistungen trainiert. Darüber hinaus ist Ihre Basis-Plus-Bezahlstruktur so konzipiert, dass der Himmel die Grenze für motivierte und kompetente Einzelhandelsverkäufer ist.
Profil
Stellen
• Profil:
Grüße Kunden auf zeitnahe, professionelle und personable Weise
Verwenden Sie Produktwissen und Auswahl, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
Erreichen Sie Ihre Verkaufsziele
Sei ein Selbststarter und nutze gutes Urteil in allen Situationen
Multitasking mit Leichtigkeit handhaben
Durchführung von Merchandising-Aufgaben; Bestandsauffüllung, visuelle Anzeige und Aktualisierung der Organisation und Sauberkeit der Speicherumgebung
Professionelle Anforderungen
Beruf

3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Key-Halter- oder Lead-Vertriebsposition
Angetrieben, um Ihren Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten
Kunden in die Kultur der Marke SWATCH einbinden
In der Lage zu arbeiten, sowie ein Teamplayer in einer schnellen, energetischen Umgebung
Fähigkeit, Ziele zu planen, zu setzen und zu erreichen
Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
Vorteile Programm
Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet, und wir freuen uns, unseren Teilzeitstellen folgende Vorteile zu bieten:
Ausgezeichnete Krankenversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag)
Mitarbeiter Produktrabatt

Internes Transfer- und Wachstumspotenzial

Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Swatch umfasst die Werte, die in der Welt der Kunst, des Designs, der Mode und der Technologie koexistieren, und verleiht ihnen einen eigenen Funken von Kreativität. So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Cutting Edge-Stil, Trend-Setting-Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen einer Swatch hinzugefügt.

Bei Swatch bieten wir unseren Retail Key-Haltern die Ausbildung und Unterstützung, die den Grundstein für eine berufliche Karriere mit echtem Momentum legt. Als Mitglied des Retail Sales Teams werden Sie auf Verkaufstechniken und Kundendienstfähigkeiten sowie technische Schulungen zu all unseren Uhren und Dienstleistungen trainiert. Darüber hinaus ist Ihre Basis-Plus-Bezahlstruktur so konzipiert, dass der Himmel die Grenze für motivierte und kompetente Einzelhandelsverkäufer ist.

Stellen

Grüße Kunden auf zeitnahe, professionelle und personable Weise

Erreichen Sie Ihre Verkaufsziele
Sei ein Selbststarter und nutze gutes Urteil in allen Situationen
Multitasking mit Leichtigkeit handhaben
Durchführung von Merchandising-Aufgaben; Bestandsauffüllung, visuelle Anzeige und Aktualisierung der Organisation und Sauberkeit der Speicherumgebung

Beruf

Angetrieben, um Ihren Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten
Kunden in die Kultur der Marke SWATCH einbinden
In der Lage zu arbeiten, sowie ein Teamplayer in einer schnellen, energetischen Umgebung
Fähigkeit, Ziele zu planen, zu setzen und zu erreichen
Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
Vorteile Programm
Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet, und wir freuen uns, unseren Teilzeitstellen folgende Vorteile zu bieten:
Ausgezeichnete Krankenversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag)

Internes Transfer- und Wachstumspotenzial

Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.

Excellentes compétences verbales et interpersonnelles

jobs.description:
Field Operation Manager - Swatch Group

Field Operation Manager
The company
Launched in 1983, Swatch is one of the world’s most iconic Swiss watchmakers, celebrated for its creativity, bold design, and provocative spirit. Constantly innovating, Swatch surprises with new models, special editions, and vibrant collaborations. The brand thrives in sports, art, and culture, offering watches as unique canvases of self-expression. With dynamic retail spaces worldwide, Swatch ambassadors bring energy, storytelling, and passion to life.
• Join us and be part of a brand that champions innovation, individuality, and joy!
• Job description
• What You'll Be Doing
• Sales & Business Performance
• Provide regular, hands-on coaching to store teams to improve sales productivity and achieve sales target.
• Analyze sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement action plans to drive improvements.
• Customer Experience & Brand Standards
• Ensure stores consistently deliver the Swatch customer experience.
• Monitor and address customer service issues, implementing improvements where necessary.
• Uphold brand presentation standards, particularly in store environment and visual merchandising.
• People Development &; Leadership
• Lead, coach, and develop store managers and assistant managers to strengthen leadership capabilities.
• Identify training needs and work with Swatch Trainer and/or HR to implement effective training programs.
• Drive succession planning and talent pipeline development for future store leaders.
• Foster a strong performance-driven culture aligned with Swatch’s values.
• Operational Excellence & Compliance
• Ensure all stores consistently follow retail SOPs, visual merchandising standards, and stock control procedures.
• Conduct routine store visit and audits, identify issues, and follow up on corrective actions.
• Support smooth execution of new launches, campaigns, and store-level initiatives.
• Store Support
• Act as the go-to person for Store Managers offering support in operations, staffing, and service-related challenges.
• Step in to support store operations during peak periods or temporary vacancies, if needed.
• Reporting
• Gather business intelligence from various sources, and the respective comments / complaints for analysis and reporting.
• Prepare and submit reports as required by the Brand HQ, Management and departments on time.
• Strategic Projects & Expansion
• Support new store openings, relocations, or refurbishments, ensuring smooth execution.
• Participate in strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
• Provide market insights to support business planning and expansion in Malaysia.
• Profile
• Diploma or Degree in Business, Retail, or related field.
• Minimum 7 years’ experience in retail operations, with at least 3 years in a multi-store management role.
• Proven track record in driving sales performance and operational excellence.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Commercially driven with strong analytical and business acumen.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with high adaptability.
• Willingness to travel frequently across Malaysia.

jobs.description:
Assistant Sales Manager (Tissot) - Swatch Group

Assistant Sales Manager (Tissot)
The company
About Tissot
Since 1853, Tissot has been at the heart of Swiss watchmaking, blending exceptional craftsmanship with a passion for precision and performance. From the iconic T-Touch to the solar-powered T-Touch Connect Solar, our pioneering spirit continues to drive innovation while honoring a rich heritage. As the Official Timekeeper for the NBA, FIBA, Tour de France, La Vuelta and MotoGP™, Tissot is trusted by the world’s top athletes and events for accuracy and reliability. We create timepieces for those who value quality, authenticity and excellence, and we bring that same commitment to our people.
Join Tissot and be part of a global team where tradition meets innovation, your ideas spark progress, and every day offers the chance to shape the future of Swiss watchmaking!
Job description
Key
• Responsibilities
Account Management/Sales
To achieve sales objectives in wholesales.
Solicit, build and maintain good support and business contacts with
dealers.
Monitor Auto Replenishment (AR) to ensure all Points of Sale (POS).
consistently comply with brand guidelines and stock allocation standards.
Track AR performance across POS, identifying gaps and driving corrective
actions to ensure alignment with brand requirements and product
availability.
Stocks and Collection
Ensure that payments are collected within the timeline given.
To do inventory analysis on bi-weekly basis.
Keeping stocks inventory healthy at all times.
Execute ordering and replenishment activities for Tissot through Arkieva,
ensuring accurate demand planning and timely stock fulfilment.
Reporting
Submit weekly/monthly progressive report of sales performance, retailers’ performance.
Prepare and submit regular sales reports to the Brand Manager, ensuring
accurate and timely performance tracking and insights.
Consolidate and upload monthly store visit reports into Mystore,
maintaining consistency and completeness of field activity documentation.
Marketing & Advertising
Collaborate closely with the marketing team to execute VM updates, GWP setups, visual merchandising refreshes, campaign rollouts, and in-store sales activations to ensure consistent brand presentation and execution excellence.
Support the monitoring and tracking of press coverage and PR activities, and report key updates to the Marketing Team and Brand Manager to ensure timely communication and alignment.
Coordinate with team members to improve product environment in Point of Sales.
Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure all Points of Sale (POS) are well maintained and consistently presented in line with Brand image.
Ensure products are displayed according to Brand Merchandising guidelines.

jobs.description:
Sales & Business Development Manager - Swatch Group

Sales & Business Development Manager
The company
EM Microelectronic is a semiconductor manufacturer specialized in the design and production of ultra-low power, low voltage integrated circuits for battery-operated and field-powered applications in consumer, automotive and industrial areas. Part of the Swatch Group and active for almost 50 years, EM is headquartered in Switzerland, has affiliates in the U.S.A., Czech Republic and Thailand and employs approximately 700 people worldwide.
Job description
• Senior business development/sales professional with a strong technical background (BSEE), extensive semiconductor sales, account management and new business development experience.
• This role is based at our headquarters in Marin/Neuchâtel with no remote or hybrid work possibility.
• Proven track record of successfully selling direct to customers, and through reps & distribution channels.
• Your essential duties and responsibilities:
• Field sales and marketing activities for all of EM’s products and customers
• KPIs: sales revenue and design wins
• Develop sales strategies for the territory in alignment with company objectives to achieve growth & revenue targets
• Identify and develop new customers, market segments and opportunities
• Identify, qualify and manage sales channels, reps and distributors
• Engage with eco-system partners to bring to the market complete solutions focusing on EM chips
• Analyze and understand the competitive landscape and work together with the BUs to adjust the EM positioning, strategy, as well as future product development
• Provide support to customers from design phase through mass production
• Establish and maintain key customer relationships at all levels, including Engineering, Purchasing, Logistics, and Management
• Drive C-level interaction between EM and customers / eco-system partners
• Lead the commercial negotiations and drive the execution of development contracts with the different internal and external stakeholders (R&D, legal, quality and logistics)
• Travel as needed for customer engagement and business development
• Profile
• To be successful in this position you need to bring along following core competencies:
• Experience selling connectivity and RFID solutions – BLE, Wireless, RFID, NFC, IoT and Sensor applications
• Business development – green field opportunity identification, qualification and design in
• Good network within the territory, with particular focus on Germany
• Account penetration at all levels, including engineering, business management, and purchasing
• Identification of key stakeholders and relationship building
• Strong communication skills, ability to articulate EM’s value proposition in a crisp and concise manner, adapted to the target audience
• Excellent listener, good understanding of customer organizational dynamics, navigating through the customer platforms & systems to maximize sales & product fit
• Technical sales of proprietary & complex solutions at the architecture & concept stages
• Comfortable with C-level and Engineering level interactions
• Understanding of eco-system sales and engagement with relevant partners
• Autonomy and initiative, ability to operate remotely and interact effectively across the entire EM organization
• Professional requirements
• Minimum 10 years of experience in selling technology in the electronics/semiconductor space
• Background with ASICs, mixed signal IC’s, BLE, Sensors, NFC, RFID, and wireless is a must
• Education: Minimum BSEE or equivalent
• Language skills: English and french are mandatory, German is a plus
• Ability to prioritize, multi task, and to work with minimal guidance and supervision
• Self-motivated, enthusiastic team player, professional attitude & work ethic, strong interpersonal skills, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication and networking skills
• Languages
• Fluent in English and French are mandatory
• German or any other language are an advantage
• Job location
• Rue des Sors 3
• 2074 Marin (Neuchatel)
• Switzerland
• Company address
• EM Microelectronic-Marin Ltd
• CH-2074 Marin-Epagnier

Sales & Business Development Manager - Swatch Group

Sales & Business Development Manager
L'azienda
EM Microelectronic è un produttore di semiconduttori specializzato nella progettazione e produzione di circuiti integrati ultra-bassi, a bassa tensione per applicazioni a batteria e alimentate a campo in aree di consumo, automotive e industriali. Parte del Gruppo Swatch e attiva da quasi 50 anni, EM ha sede in Svizzera, ha affiliati negli Stati Uniti, nella Repubblica Ceca e in Thailandia e impiega circa 700 persone in tutto il mondo.
Descrizione del lavoro
• Senior business development/sales professional con un forte background tecnico (BSEE), vendite estese di semiconduttori, gestione account e nuova esperienza di sviluppo aziendale.
• Questo ruolo si basa nella nostra sede a Marin/Neuchâtel senza possibilità di lavoro remote o ibride.
• Provato record di traccia di vendita con successo diretto ai clienti, e attraverso reps & canali di distribuzione.
• I vostri doveri e responsabilità essenziali:
• Attività di vendita e marketing sul campo per tutti i prodotti e i clienti di EM
• KPI: vincite di fatturato e design
• Sviluppare strategie di vendita per il territorio in allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali per raggiungere obiettivi di crescita e ricavi
• Identificare e sviluppare nuovi clienti, segmenti di mercato e opportunità
• Identificare, qualificare e gestire canali di vendita, rep e distributori
• Impegnarsi con partner eco-sistema per portare al mercato soluzioni complete incentrate su chip EM
• Analizzare e comprendere il paesaggio competitivo e lavorare insieme con i BU per regolare il posizionamento EM, la strategia, così come il futuro sviluppo del prodotto
• Fornire supporto ai clienti dalla fase di progettazione attraverso la produzione di massa
• Stabilire e mantenere le relazioni con i clienti chiave a tutti i livelli, tra cui Ingegneria, Acquisizione, Logistica e Gestione
• Guidare l'interazione a livello C tra EM e clienti / partner eco-sistema
• Guidare i negoziati commerciali e guidare l'esecuzione dei contratti di sviluppo con i diversi stakeholder interni ed esterni (R&D, legale, qualità e logistica)
• Viaggiare come necessario per l'impegno del cliente e lo sviluppo aziendale
• Profilo
• Per avere successo in questa posizione è necessario portare avanti le seguenti competenze principali:
• Esperienza di vendita di connettività e soluzioni RFID – applicazioni BLE, Wireless, RFID, NFC, IoT e Sensor
• Sviluppo aziendale – identificazione delle opportunità sul campo verde, qualificazione e progettazione
• Buona rete all'interno del territorio, con particolare attenzione alla Germania
• penetrazione dell'account a tutti i livelli, tra cui ingegneria, gestione aziendale e acquisto
• Identificazione dei principali stakeholder e della costruzione di relazioni
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, capacità di articolare la proposta di valore di EM in modo croccante e conciso, adattata al pubblico di destinazione
• Eccellente ascoltatore, buona comprensione delle dinamiche organizzative dei clienti, navigando attraverso le piattaforme e i sistemi dei clienti per massimizzare le vendite e la vestibilità dei prodotti
• Vendita tecnica di soluzioni proprietarie e complesse nelle fasi di architettura e concept
• Confortevole con interazioni a livello C e livello di ingegneria
• Comprensione delle vendite eco-sistema e del coinvolgimento con partner rilevanti
• Autonomia e iniziativa, capacità di operare da remoto e interagire efficacemente in tutta l'organizzazione EM
• Requisiti professionali
• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nella vendita di tecnologia nello spazio elettronico/semiconduttore
• Background con ASIC, segnale misto IC, BLE, sensori, NFC, RFID e wireless è un must
• Istruzione: minimo BSEE o equivalente
• competenze linguistiche: inglese e francese sono obbligatori, il tedesco è un plus
• Capacità di priorità, multi compito, e di lavorare con una guida minima e supervisione
• Giocatore di squadra automotivato, entusiasta, atteggiamento professionale & lavoro etico, forti competenze interpersonali, e dettagli
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e networking
• Lingue
• Fluente in inglese e francese sono obbligatori
• Tedesco o qualsiasi altra lingua sono un vantaggio

Sales & Business Development Manager - Swatch Group

Vertriebs- und Business Development Manager
Das Unternehmen
EM Microelectronic ist ein Halbleiterhersteller, der sich auf die Konstruktion und Herstellung von Ultra-Low-Power-, Niederspannungs-integrierten Schaltungen für batteriebetriebene und feldbetriebene Anwendungen in Verbraucher-, Automobil- und Industriebereichen spezialisiert hat. Teil der Swatch Group und seit fast 50 Jahren aktiv, ist EM mit Sitz in der Schweiz, hat Tochtergesellschaften in den USA, Tschechien und Thailand und beschäftigt rund 700 Mitarbeiter weltweit.
Jobbeschreibung
• Senior Business Development/Sales Professional mit einem starken technischen Hintergrund (BSEE), umfangreichen Halbleiter-Vertrieb, Kontomanagement und neue Geschäftsentwicklungserfahrung.
• Diese Rolle basiert an unserem Hauptsitz in Marin/Neuchâtel ohne Remote- oder Hybrid-Arbeitsmöglichkeit.
• Nachweis der Erfolgsbilanz beim Verkauf direkt an Kunden und durch Reps & Distributionskanäle.
• Ihre wesentlichen Aufgaben und Aufgaben:
• Vertriebs- und Marketingaktivitäten für alle Produkte und Kunden von EM
• Kennzahlen: Umsatz und Design gewinnt
• Entwicklung von Vertriebsstrategien für das Gebiet im Einklang mit Unternehmenszielen zur Erreichung von Wachstums- und Umsatzzielen
• Neue Kunden, Marktsegmente und Chancen identifizieren und entwickeln
• Identifizierung, Qualifizierung und Verwaltung von Vertriebskanälen, Repräsentanten und Händlern
• Mit Eco-System-Partnern auf den Markt bringen komplette Lösungen mit Fokus auf EM-Chips
• Analysieren und verstehen Sie die wettbewerbsfähige Landschaft und arbeiten zusammen mit den BUs, um die EM-Positionierung, Strategie sowie zukünftige Produktentwicklung anzupassen
• Kunden von der Designphase bis zur Massenproduktion unterstützen
• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung der wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen auf allen Ebenen, einschließlich Engineering, Einkauf, Logistik und Management
• C-Level-Interaktion zwischen EM und Kunden / Ecosystem-Partnern
• Führen Sie die Handelsverhandlungen und führen Sie die Durchführung von Entwicklungsverträgen mit den verschiedenen internen und externen Akteuren (FuE, Rechts-, Qualitäts- und Logistik)
• Reisen nach Bedarf für Kundenbindung und Geschäftsentwicklung
• Profil
• Um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, müssen Sie folgende Kernkompetenzen mitbringen:
• Erleben Sie den Verkauf von Connectivity und RFID-Lösungen – BLE, Wireless, RFID, NFC, IoT und Sensor-Anwendungen
• Geschäftsentwicklung – Green Field Chance Identifikation, Qualifikation und Design in
• Gutes Netz innerhalb des Territoriums, mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf Deutschland
• Kontodurchdringung auf allen Ebenen, einschließlich Engineering, Business Management und Einkauf
• Identifizierung der wichtigsten Interessengruppen und des Beziehungsaufbaus
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit, die Wertvorstellung von EM skeptisch und präzise an das Zielpublikum angepasst zu artikulieren
• Hervorragender Zuhörer, gutes Verständnis der Kundenorganisationsdynamik, navigieren durch die Kundenplattformen & Systeme, um den Vertrieb & Produkt fit zu maximieren
• Technischer Vertrieb von proprietären und komplexen Lösungen in den Architektur- und Konzeptstadien
• Bequem mit C-Level und Engineering-Level-Interaktionen
• Verständnis von Umsatz und Engagement des Ökosystems mit relevanten Partnern
• Autonomie und Initiative, Fähigkeit, Remote zu betreiben und effektiv über die gesamte EM-Organisation zu interagieren
• Professionelle Anforderungen
• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verkaufstechnologie im Elektronik-/Halbleiterraum
• Hintergrund mit ASICs, Mixed Signal ICs, BLE, Sensoren, NFC, RFID und Wireless ist ein Muss
• Ausbildung: Minimum BSEE oder gleichwertig
• Sprachkenntnisse: Englisch und Französisch sind obligatorisch, Deutsch ist ein Plus
• Fähigkeit zur Priorisierung, Multiaufgabe und zur Arbeit mit minimaler Führung und Aufsicht
• Selbstmotivierter, begeisterter Teamplayer, professionelle Einstellung & Arbeitsethik, starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und detailorientierte
• Starke Kommunikations- und Netzwerkfähigkeiten
• Sprachen
• Flöten in Englisch und Französisch sind obligatorisch
• Deutsch oder jede andere Sprache ist ein Vorteil

Sales & Business Development Manager - Swatch Group

Directeur des ventes et du développement des affaires
La société
EM Microelectronic est un fabricant de semi-conducteurs spécialisé dans la conception et la production de circuits intégrés ultra-faible puissance, basse tension pour les applications à piles et sur le terrain dans les secteurs de consommation, automobile et industriel. Membre du groupe Swatch et actif depuis près de 50 ans, EM a son siège social en Suisse, ses filiales aux États-Unis, en République tchèque et en Thaïlande et emploie environ 700 personnes dans le monde.
Description du poste
• Professionnel senior de développement/ventes avec une solide expérience technique (BSEE), des ventes de semi-conducteurs, la gestion de compte et une nouvelle expérience de développement d'entreprise.
• Ce rôle est basé à notre siège à Marin/Neuchâtel sans possibilité de travail à distance ou hybride.
• Expérience éprouvée de la vente directe avec succès aux clients, et par le biais de la représentation et des canaux de distribution.
• Vos devoirs et responsabilités essentiels :
• Activités de vente et de commercialisation sur le terrain pour tous les produits et clients EM
• KPI : les recettes de vente et la conception gagnent
• Développer des stratégies de vente pour le territoire conformément aux objectifs de l'entreprise pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance et de revenus
• Identifier et développer de nouveaux clients, segments de marché et opportunités
• Identifier, qualifier et gérer les canaux de vente, les représentants et les distributeurs
• S'engager avec les partenaires éco-systèmes pour mettre sur le marché des solutions complètes axées sur les puces EM
• Analyser et comprendre le paysage concurrentiel et travailler avec les BU pour ajuster le positionnement EM, la stratégie et le développement futur des produits
• Fournir un soutien aux clients de la phase de conception à la production de masse
• Établir et maintenir des relations client clés à tous les niveaux, y compris l'ingénierie, les achats, la logistique et la gestion
• Favoriser l'interaction au niveau C entre EM et clients/partenaires de l'écosystème
• Diriger les négociations commerciales et conduire l'exécution des contrats de développement avec les différents acteurs internes et externes (R-D, juridique, qualité et logistique)
• Voyages au besoin pour l'engagement des clients et le développement des affaires
• Profil
• Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez apporter les compétences de base suivantes:
• Expérience de vente de solutions de connectivité et RFID – applications BLE, sans fil, RFID, NFC, IoT et capteurs
• Développement des entreprises – identification des opportunités de terrain vert, qualification et conception
• Bon réseau sur le territoire, en particulier en Allemagne
• Pénétration des comptes à tous les niveaux, y compris l'ingénierie, la gestion d'entreprise et l'achat
• Identification des principales parties prenantes et établissement de relations
• Fortes compétences en communication, capacité d'articuler la proposition de valeur EM=s d'une manière claire et concise, adaptée au public cible
• Excellent auditeur, bonne compréhension de la dynamique de l'organisation des clients, navigation à travers les plates-formes et systèmes clients pour maximiser les ventes et l'ajustement des produits
• Ventes techniques de solutions exclusives et complexes aux étapes de l'architecture et du concept
• Confortable avec les interactions de niveau C et de niveau Engineering
• Compréhension des ventes d'écosystèmes et engagement avec les partenaires concernés
• Autonomie et initiative, capacité de fonctionner à distance et d'interagir efficacement dans toute l'organisation EM
• Exigences professionnelles
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la vente de technologie dans l'espace électronique/semi-conducteur
• Le fond avec ASIC, le signal mixte IC, BLE, Capteurs, NFC, RFID et sans fil est un must
• Éducation: ESE minimum ou équivalent
• Compétences linguistiques: Anglais et français sont obligatoires, l'allemand est un plus
• Aptitude à établir des priorités, des tâches multiples et à travailler avec un minimum d'orientation et de supervision
• Joueur d'équipe automotivé, enthousiaste, attitude professionnelle et éthique du travail, fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et axées sur le détail

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Green Hills (Nashville) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Green Hills (Nashville)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
At Swatch we provide our Retail Key holders with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.
Profile
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Handle multi-tasking with ease
• Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
• Professional requirements
• 3-5 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
• Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
• Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
• Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to plan, set and achieve goals
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
• Benefits Program

• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year

• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay

Swatch Part Time Portachiavi - Millenia (Orlando) - Swatch Group Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Millenia (Orlando) L'azienda Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti. Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettronica e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie. Descrizione del lavoro Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nel mondo dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia e li dona la propria scintilla di creatività. Così, Swatch è considerato una tela su cui sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile taglio bordo, impostazione tendenza look e accenti tecnologia amichevole hanno tutti aggiunto allo stupore di possedere un Swatch. A Swatch forniamo ai nostri portachiavi al dettaglio la formazione e il supporto che pone le basi per una carriera professionale con slancio reale. Come membro del Retail Sales Team, sarete istruiti sulle tecniche di vendita e sulle competenze del servizio clienti, insieme alla formazione tecnica su tutti i nostri orologi e servizi. Inoltre, la vostra struttura di pagamento base-plus-commission è progettata in modo che il cielo è il limite per professionisti di vendita al dettaglio motivati e competenti. Profilo
• Greet clienti in modo tempestivo, professionale e personable
• Utilizzare la conoscenza e la selezione del prodotto per fornire un servizio eccezionale e costruire relazioni con i clienti
• Raggiungere & superare i vostri obiettivi di vendita
•
• Promuovere un'assicurazione sul lavoro per l'assicurazione sulla vita e l'assicurazione sulla vita per i genitori:

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Millenia (Orlando) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Millenia (Orlando)
Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Jobbeschreibung
Swatch umfasst die Werte, die in der Welt der Kunst, des Designs, der Mode und der Technologie koexistieren, und verleiht ihnen einen eigenen Funken von Kreativität. So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Cutting Edge-Stil, Trend-Setting-Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen einer Swatch hinzugefügt.
Bei Swatch bieten wir unseren Retail Key-Haltern die Ausbildung und Unterstützung, die den Grundstein für eine berufliche Karriere mit echtem Momentum legt. Als Mitglied des Retail Sales Teams werden Sie auf Verkaufstechniken und Kundendienstfähigkeiten sowie technische Schulungen zu all unseren Uhren und Dienstleistungen trainiert. Darüber hinaus ist Ihre Basis-Plus-Bezahlstruktur so konzipiert, dass der Himmel die Grenze für motivierte und kompetente Einzelhandelsverkäufer ist.
Profil
• Grüße Kunden in einer zeitnahen, professionellen und personablen Weise
• Verwenden Sie Produktwissen und Auswahl, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
• Erreichen Sie Ihre Verkaufsziele
• Sei ein Selbststarter und nutze ein gutes Urteil in allen Situationen
• Multitasking mit Leichtigkeit handhaben
• Durchführung von Merchandising-Aufgaben; Bestandsauffüllung, visuelle Anzeige und Aktualisierung der Organisation und Sauberkeit der Speicherumgebung
• Professionelle Anforderungen
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Key-Halter- oder Lead-Vertriebsposition
• Angetrieben, um Ihren Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten
• Kunden in die Kultur der Marke SWATCH einbinden
• Able, um auch einen Teamplayer in einer schnellen, energetischen Umgebung zu arbeiten
• Fähigkeit, Ziele zu planen, festzulegen und zu erreichen
• Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
• Vorteile Programm
• Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet und wir freuen uns, ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket anzubieten, das Folgendes umfasst:

jobs.description:
Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst - Swatch Group

Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with internal SAP teams, IT departments, business stakeholders and external partners, you will contribute to major transformation initiatives and ensure the continuous improvement of SAP processes.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Gather, analyze and challenge business requirements to ensure alignment with global processes.
• Propose robust and scalable SAP solutions and perform system configuration.
• Prepare detailed functional specifications and collaborate closely with SAP developers.
• Train key users and support change management activities.
• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Non‑Regression Testing (NRT).
• Act as module lead on projects and contribute to cross‑functional initiatives.
• Maintain up‑to‑date documentation on processes, configurations and system design.
• Analyze and resolve complex incidents and provide expert-level operational support.
• Manage enhancements and continuous improvement activities within your SAP domain.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• A strong track record as a Senior SAP expert, delivering high‑impact solutions in global environments.
• Deep understanding of business processes and SAP integration, especially across FI/CO and EWM.
• The ability to translate complex business needs into scalable, future‑proof SAP configurations.
• Confidence acting as a functional lead, driving workshops and influencing key decisions.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business teams, IT, developers, and external partners.
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with autonomy in handling complex issues.
• A proactive, customer‑focused mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
• The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 7+ years of SAP customizing experience in major implementation or transformation projects.
• Strong understanding of ABAP concepts and integration technologies (EDI, API, RFC).
• Solid knowledge of business processes and SAP integration, especially FI/CO and EWM.
• Hands‑on experience with SAP S/4HANA and awareness of recent SAP innovations.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.
• Strong organizational abilities and capacity to manage multiple priorities.
• Customer‑focused mindset with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Informatics, or equivalent; SAP FI/CO certification is an asset.

jobs.title: Senior SAP Developer
jobs.description:
Senior SAP Developer - Swatch Group

Senior SAP Developer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing, developing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with SAP Business Analysts, functional teams and technical stakeholders, you will analyze requirements, build robust SAP developments, contribute to project activities and ensure the long‑term reliability and performance of SAP applications.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Analyzing business requirements together with SAP Business Analysts and translating them into technical SAP solutions.
• Designing, developing, documenting and maintaining SAP programs and enhancements.
• Evaluating change requests, proposing technical designs and implementing scalable solutions.
• Supporting Fit/Gap analysis, data migration activities and go‑live phases within SAP projects.
• Creating and maintaining functional and technical specifications, including test cases.
• Collaborating closely with Business Analysts and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment between functional needs and technical delivery.
• Ensuring adherence to SAP development best practices, performance standards and code quality guidelines.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Extensive experience as an SAP Developer with strong expertise in ABAP and modern SAP development frameworks.
• Deep understanding of SAP modules such as FI, CO, MM, SD, QM and experience with SAP Solution Manager.
• Strong ability to translate functional requirements into robust, scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
• Hands‑on experience with S/4HANA development, CDS views, OData services and RESTful programming.
• Experience building Fiori applications end‑to‑end and applying best practices for modern SAP UX.
• Solid knowledge of integration technologies including IDocs, ALE, RFC and API‑based communication.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities.
• The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within technical and functional teams.
• A passion for development, continuous learning and delivering high‑quality solutions in an international environment.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development across multiple modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, QM).
• Strong experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
• In‑depth knowledge of ABAP, Adobe Forms, SmartForms, SAPScripts and performance‑optimized coding.
• Expertise in IDocs, ALE, SQL and JavaScript.
• Strong experience with CDS views, OData services and SAP RESTful ABAP programming.
• Ability to build Fiori applications from end to end.
• Experience with backend service creation and exposure to external applications.
• Familiarity with ATC, code quality standards and Fiori‑based modernization of legacy developments.
• Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is an advantage (APIs, Cloud Events, BAS, Fiori Elements, Build).
• Knowledge of extensibility best practices in S/4HANA Cloud and use of Custom Business Objects.
• Experience with low‑code platforms (Neptune, Mendix) and basic Java knowledge.
• Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving abilities and a customer‑oriented mindset.
• University degree in Information Technology, Information Management or equivalent.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.
